+def sourceTerm {X : Type} (u : Source) : Term X :=
+  FreeMagma.lift (fun b : Bool => .of (.inl b)) u
+
+def decodeHoleFree : HoleExterior → Option Source
+  | .of (.inl b) => some (.of b)
+  | .of (.inr _) => none
+  | .mul l r =>
+      match decodeHoleFree l, decodeHoleFree r with
+      | some u, some v => some (.mul u v)
+      | _, _ => none
+
+def bindingHolds {X : Type} (v : X → Source) : List (X × Term X) → Prop
+  | [] => True
+  | (x, t) :: rest => v x = evaluate v t ∧ bindingHolds v rest
+
+def matchExterior {X : Type} : SymbolicExterior X → HoleExterior →
+    Option (List (X × Term X))
+  | .of (.inl (.inl b)), .of (.inl c) =>
+      if b = c then some [] else none
+  | .of (.inl (.inl _)), _ => none
+  | .of (.inl (.inr x)), u =>
+      (decodeHoleFree u).map (fun s => [(x, sourceTerm s)])
+  | .of (.inr q), .of (.inr r) =>
+      if q = r then some [] else none
+  | .of (.inr _), _ => none
+  | .mul p q, .mul u v =>
+      match matchExterior p u, matchExterior q v with
+      | some bp, some bq => some (bp ++ bq)
+      | _, _ => none
+  | .mul _ _, _ => none
+
+private theorem evaluate_sourceTerm {X : Type} (v : X → Source) (u : Source) :
+    evaluate v (sourceTerm u) = u :=
+  NativeWholeRowService.evaluate_embedded v u
+
+private theorem decodeHoleFree_sound (u : HoleExterior) (s : Source)
+    (h : decodeHoleFree u = some s) : FreeMagma.map Sum.inl s = u := by
+  induction u generalizing s with
+  | of a =>
+      cases a with
+      | inl b =>
+          simp only [decodeHoleFree] at h
+          cases h
+          rfl
+      | inr q => simp [decodeHoleFree] at h
+  | mul l r ihl ihr =>
+      cases hs : decodeHoleFree l with
+      | none => simp [decodeHoleFree, hs] at h
+      | some sl =>
+          cases hr : decodeHoleFree r with
+          | none => simp [decodeHoleFree, hs, hr] at h
+          | some sr =>
+              cases s with
+              | of b => simp [decodeHoleFree, hs, hr] at h
+              | mul s₁ s₂ =>
+                  simp only [decodeHoleFree, hs, hr, Option.some.injEq] at h
+                  cases h
+                  exact congrArg₂ FreeMagma.mul (ihl sl hs) (ihr sr hr)
+
+private theorem decodeHoleFree_map (s : Source) :
+    decodeHoleFree (FreeMagma.map Sum.inl s) = some s := by
+  induction s with
+  | of b => rfl
+  | mul l r ihl ihr =>
+      change decodeHoleFree
+        (FreeMagma.mul (FreeMagma.map Sum.inl l) (FreeMagma.map Sum.inl r)) = _
+      simp [decodeHoleFree, ihl, ihr]
+
+private theorem bindingHolds_append {X : Type} (v : X → Source)
+    (a b : List (X × Term X)) :
+    bindingHolds v (a ++ b) ↔ bindingHolds v a ∧ bindingHolds v b := by
+  induction a with
+  | nil => simp [bindingHolds]
+  | cons h a ih =>
+      cases h with
+      | mk x t => simp only [List.cons_append, bindingHolds, ih, and_assoc]
+
+private theorem matchExterior_sound {X : Type} (p : SymbolicExterior X)
+    (u : HoleExterior) (v : X → Source) (bs : List (X × Term X))
+    (hm : matchExterior p u = some bs) (hb : bindingHolds v bs) :
+    exteriorFill v p = u := by
+  induction p generalizing u bs with
+  | of a =>
+      cases a with
+      | inl a =>
+          cases a with
+          | inl b =>
+              cases u with
+              | of c =>
+                  cases c with
+                  | inl c =>
+                      simp only [matchExterior] at hm
+                      split at hm <;> simp_all [exteriorFill]
+                  | inr q => simp [matchExterior] at hm
+              | mul l r => simp [matchExterior] at hm
+          | inr x =>
+              obtain ⟨s, hs, hbs⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp hm
+              subst bs
+              have hxs : v x = s := by
+                simpa [bindingHolds, evaluate_sourceTerm] using hb
+              have hmap := decodeHoleFree_sound u s hs
+              simpa [exteriorFill, hxs] using hmap
+      | inr q =>
+          cases u with
+          | of c =>
+              cases c with
+              | inl b => simp [matchExterior] at hm
+              | inr r =>
+                  simp only [matchExterior] at hm
+                  split at hm <;> simp_all [exteriorFill]
+          | mul l r => simp [matchExterior] at hm
+  | mul p q ihp ihq =>
+      cases u with
+      | of a => simp [matchExterior] at hm
+      | mul u w =>
+          cases hpm : matchExterior p u with
+          | none => simp [matchExterior, hpm] at hm
+          | some bp =>
+              cases hqm : matchExterior q w with
+              | none => simp [matchExterior, hpm, hqm] at hm
+              | some bq =>
+                  have hbs : bp ++ bq = bs := by
+                    simpa [matchExterior, hpm, hqm] using hm
+                  rw [← hbs] at hb
+                  have hsplit := (bindingHolds_append v bp bq).mp hb
+                  change exteriorFill v p * exteriorFill v q = u * w
+                  rw [ihp u bp hpm hsplit.1, ihq w bq hqm hsplit.2]
+
+private theorem matchExterior_complete {X : Type} (p : SymbolicExterior X)
+    (u : HoleExterior) (v : X → Source) (he : exteriorFill v p = u) :
+    ∃ bs, matchExterior p u = some bs ∧ bindingHolds v bs := by
+  induction p generalizing u with
+  | of a =>
+      cases a with
+      | inl a =>
+          cases a with
+          | inl b =>
+              cases u with
+              | of c =>
+                  cases c with
+                  | inl c =>
+                      simp only [exteriorFill] at he
+                      have : b = c := by cases he; rfl
+                      subst c
+                      exact ⟨[], by simp [matchExterior], trivial⟩
+                  | inr q => cases he
+              | mul l r => cases he
+          | inr x =>
+              have hd : decodeHoleFree u = some (v x) := by
+                rw [← he]
+                simp [exteriorFill, decodeHoleFree_map]
+              exact ⟨[(x, sourceTerm (v x))], by
+                simp [matchExterior, hd, evaluate_sourceTerm, bindingHolds]⟩
+      | inr q =>
+          cases u with
+          | of c =>
+              cases c with
+              | inl b => cases he
+              | inr r =>
+                  have : q = r := by cases he; rfl
+                  subst r
+                  exact ⟨[], by simp [matchExterior], trivial⟩
+          | mul l r => cases he
+  | mul p q ihp ihq =>
+      cases u with
+      | of a => simp [exteriorFill] at he
+      | mul u w =>
+          have hp : exteriorFill v p = u := by injection he with hp _
+          have hq : exteriorFill v q = w := by injection he with _ hq
+          obtain ⟨bp, hbp, hbpp⟩ := ihp u hp
+          obtain ⟨bq, hbq, hbqq⟩ := ihq w hq
+          exact ⟨bp ++ bq, by simp [matchExterior, hbp, hbq],
+            (bindingHolds_append v bp bq).mpr ⟨hbpp, hbqq⟩⟩
+
+theorem exterior_match_exact {X : Type} (p : SymbolicExterior X)
+    (u : HoleExterior) (v : X → Source) :
+    exteriorFill v p = u ↔
+      ∃ bs, matchExterior p u = some bs ∧ bindingHolds v bs := by
+  constructor
+  · exact matchExterior_complete p u v
+  · rintro ⟨bs, hm, hb⟩
+    exact matchExterior_sound p u v bs hm hb
+
+
+
+open ActualTreeReadoutAcquisition (Address)
+open ActualCutPartitionRecovery (CutSet CutPrefixFree)
+open ActualCutPartitionDecoder (literalRecord)
+open NativeSymbolicRecutting
+  (termAt symbolicOrdered symbolicPartition symbolicRecord symbolicExterior DeepAt
+    symbolic_recut_exact)
+open NativeTermUnification (Presentation)
+open NativeGroundSolutionSpace (Equations Sol Diseq)
+
+abbrev RawRow := CutSet × HoleExterior × Finset (Address × Address)
+abbrev SignedConstraints (X : Type) := Equations X × Equations X
+
+/-- Every ordered reached pair is retained, including diagonals and both orders. -/
+def reachedPairs {X : Type} (Q : CutSet) (t : Term X) : Finset (Address × Address) :=
+  (symbolicOrdered Q t).toFinset.product (symbolicOrdered Q t).toFinset
+
+def pairTerms {X : Type} (t : Term X) (pq : Address × Address) : Term X × Term X :=
+  ((termAt pq.1 t).getD (.of (.inl false)),
+   (termAt pq.2 t).getD (.of (.inl false)))
+
+def rowPairList {X : Type} (Q : CutSet) (t : Term X) : List (Address × Address) :=
+  (symbolicOrdered Q t).product (symbolicOrdered Q t)
+
+private theorem row_pair_list_mem {X : Type} (Q : CutSet) (t : Term X)
+    (pq : Address × Address) : pq ∈ rowPairList Q t ↔ pq ∈ reachedPairs Q t := by
+  rcases pq with ⟨a, b⟩
+  simp [rowPairList, reachedPairs]
+
+def positivePairs {X : Type} (Q : CutSet) (t : Term X)
+    (K : Finset (Address × Address)) : Equations X :=
+  ((rowPairList Q t).filter (fun pq => decide (pq ∈ K))).map (pairTerms t)
+
+def negativePairs {X : Type} (Q : CutSet) (t : Term X)
+    (K : Finset (Address × Address)) : Equations X :=
+  ((rowPairList Q t).filter (fun pq => decide (pq ∉ K))).map (pairTerms t)
+
+def bindingEquations {X : Type} (bs : List (X × Term X)) : Equations X :=
+  bs.map (fun b => (.of (.inr b.1), b.2))
+
+def constraintsHold {X : Type} (c : SignedConstraints X) (v : X → Source) : Prop :=
+  Sol c.1 v ∧ Diseq c.2 v
+
+def mergeConstraints {X : Type} (a b : SignedConstraints X) : SignedConstraints X :=
+  (a.1 ++ b.1, a.2 ++ b.2)
+
+/-- Raw labels are checked against the actual symbolic reached set. No
+partition validity or attained-label certificate is supplied. -/
+def compileRow {X : Type} (t : Term X) (r : RawRow) : Option (SignedConstraints X) :=
+  if r.2.2 ⊆ reachedPairs r.1 t then
+    (matchExterior (symbolicExterior r.1 [] t) r.2.1).map
+      (fun bs => (bindingEquations bs ++ positivePairs r.1 t r.2.2,
+        negativePairs r.1 t r.2.2))
+  else none
+
+def compileRows {X : Type} (t : Term X) : List RawRow → Option (SignedConstraints X)
+  | [] => some ([], [])
+  | r :: rs => do
+      let a ← compileRow t r
+      let b ← compileRows t rs
+      pure (mergeConstraints a b)
+
+private theorem binding_equations_exact {X : Type} (v : X → Source)
+    (bs : List (X × Term X)) : Sol (bindingEquations bs) v ↔ bindingHolds v bs := by
+  induction bs with
+  | nil => simp [Sol, bindingEquations, bindingHolds]
+  | cons b bs ih =>
+      simp only [bindingEquations, List.map_cons, Sol, List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp]
+      change (v b.1 = evaluate v b.2 ∧ Sol (bindingEquations bs) v) ↔ _
+      rw [ih]
+      rfl
+
+private theorem constraints_merge_exact {X : Type} (a b : SignedConstraints X)
+    (v : X → Source) :
+    constraintsHold (mergeConstraints a b) v ↔ constraintsHold a v ∧ constraintsHold b v := by
+  simp only [constraintsHold, mergeConstraints, Sol, Diseq, List.mem_append,
+    or_imp, forall_and]
+  tauto
+
+private theorem pair_terms_exact {X : Type} (Q : CutSet) (t : Term X)
+    (v : X → Source) (pq : Address × Address) (hp : pq ∈ reachedPairs Q t) :
+    (termAt pq.1 t).map (evaluate v) = (termAt pq.2 t).map (evaluate v) ↔
+      evaluate v (pairTerms t pq).1 = evaluate v (pairTerms t pq).2 := by
+  have hp' := Finset.mem_product.mp hp
+  have h₁ : (termAt pq.1 t).isSome := by
+    have h := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ((Finset.mem_sort _).mp
+      (List.mem_toFinset.mp hp'.1))).2
+    exact h
+  have h₂ : (termAt pq.2 t).isSome := by
+    have h := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ((Finset.mem_sort _).mp
+      (List.mem_toFinset.mp hp'.2))).2
+    exact h
+  cases ha : termAt pq.1 t <;> cases hb : termAt pq.2 t <;>
+    simp_all [pairTerms]
+
+private theorem partition_constraints_exact {X : Type} (Q : CutSet) (t : Term X)
+    (K : Finset (Address × Address)) (v : X → Source) :
+    symbolicPartition Q t v = K ↔ K ⊆ reachedPairs Q t ∧
+      Sol (positivePairs Q t K) v ∧ Diseq (negativePairs Q t K) v := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · intro pq hp
+      rw [← h] at hp
+      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
+    · intro c hc
+      obtain ⟨pq, hpq, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
+      obtain ⟨hp, hk⟩ : pq ∈ reachedPairs Q t ∧ pq ∈ K := by
+        simpa only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq, row_pair_list_mem] using hpq
+      have hs : pq ∈ symbolicPartition Q t v := h.symm ▸ hk
+      exact (pair_terms_exact Q t v pq hp).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2
+    · intro c hc he
+      obtain ⟨pq, hpq, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
+      obtain ⟨hp, hk⟩ : pq ∈ reachedPairs Q t ∧ pq ∉ K := by
+        simpa only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq, row_pair_list_mem] using hpq
+      apply hk
+      rw [← h]
+      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, (pair_terms_exact Q t v pq hp).mpr he⟩
+  · rintro ⟨sub, pos, neg⟩
+    ext pq
+    constructor
+    · intro hpq
+      obtain ⟨hp, he⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hpq
+      by_contra hk
+      apply neg (pairTerms t pq) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨pq,
+        (by simpa only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq, row_pair_list_mem]
+          using (show pq ∈ reachedPairs Q t ∧ pq ∉ K from ⟨hp, hk⟩)), rfl⟩)
+      exact (pair_terms_exact Q t v pq hp).mp he
+    · intro hk
+      have hp := sub hk
+      apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
+      refine ⟨hp, (pair_terms_exact Q t v pq hp).mpr ?_⟩
+      exact pos (pairTerms t pq) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨pq,
+        (by simpa only [List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq, row_pair_list_mem]
+          using (show pq ∈ reachedPairs Q t ∧ pq ∈ K from ⟨hp, hk⟩)), rfl⟩)
+
+private theorem compile_row_exact {X : Type} (t : Term X) (r : RawRow)
+    (v : X → Source) :
+    symbolicRecord r.1 t v = r.2 ↔
+      ∃ c, compileRow t r = some c ∧ constraintsHold c v := by
+  rcases r with ⟨Q, u, K⟩
+  change (exteriorFill v (symbolicExterior Q [] t), symbolicPartition Q t v) = (u, K) ↔ _
+  rw [Prod.mk.injEq, partition_constraints_exact]
+  by_cases sub : K ⊆ reachedPairs Q t
+  · cases hm : matchExterior (symbolicExterior Q [] t) u with
+    | none =>
+        have no : exteriorFill v (symbolicExterior Q [] t) ≠ u := by
+          intro he
+          obtain ⟨bs, hb, _⟩ := (exterior_match_exact _ _ v).mp he
+          rw [hm] at hb
+          cases hb
+        simp [compileRow, sub, hm, no]
+    | some bs =>
+        have ext : exteriorFill v (symbolicExterior Q [] t) = u ↔ bindingHolds v bs := by
+          constructor
+          · intro he
+            obtain ⟨cs, hc, hh⟩ := (exterior_match_exact _ _ v).mp he
+            rw [hm] at hc
+            cases hc
+            exact hh
+          · exact fun hb => (exterior_match_exact _ _ v).mpr ⟨bs, hm, hb⟩
+        rw [ext]
+        simp only [compileRow, sub, ↓reduceIte, hm, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq,
+          exists_eq_left', constraintsHold, Sol, List.mem_append, or_imp, forall_and]
+        change (bindingHolds v bs ∧ True ∧ Sol (positivePairs Q t K) v ∧
+          Diseq (negativePairs Q t K) v) ↔
+          ((Sol (bindingEquations bs) v ∧ Sol (positivePairs Q t K) v) ∧
+            Diseq (negativePairs Q t K) v)
+        rw [binding_equations_exact]
+        simp only [true_and]
+        tauto
+  · simp [compileRow, sub]
+
+private theorem compile_rows_exact {X : Type} (t : Term X) (rs : List RawRow)
+    (v : X → Source) :
+    (∀ r ∈ rs, symbolicRecord r.1 t v = r.2) ↔
+      ∃ c, compileRows t rs = some c ∧ constraintsHold c v := by
+  induction rs with
+  | nil => simp [compileRows, constraintsHold, Sol, Diseq]
+  | cons r rs ih =>
+      simp only [List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp]
+      rw [compile_row_exact, ih]
+      constructor
+      · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha, hsa⟩, ⟨b, hb, hsb⟩⟩
+        exact ⟨mergeConstraints a b, by simp [compileRows, ha, hb],
+          (constraints_merge_exact a b v).mpr ⟨hsa, hsb⟩⟩
+      · rintro ⟨c, hc, hs⟩
+        cases ha : compileRow t r with
+        | none => simp [compileRows, ha] at hc
+        | some a =>
+            cases hb : compileRows t rs with
+            | none => simp [compileRows, ha, hb] at hc
+            | some b =>
+                have he : mergeConstraints a b = c := by simpa [compileRows, ha, hb] using hc
+                subst c
+                obtain ⟨hsa, hsb⟩ := (constraints_merge_exact a b v).mp hs
+                exact ⟨⟨a, rfl, hsa⟩, ⟨b, rfl, hsb⟩⟩
+
+/-- A simultaneous substitution may change the finite variable carrier. -/
+def rebind {X Y : Type} (theta : X → Term Y) : Term X →ₙ* Term Y :=
+  FreeMagma.lift (Sum.elim (fun b => .of (.inl b)) theta)
+
+private theorem rebind_evaluate {X Y : Type} (theta : X → Term Y)
+    (z : Y → Source) (t : Term X) :
+    NativeTermUnification.evaluate z (rebind theta t) =
+      NativeTermUnification.evaluate (fun x => evaluate z (theta x)) t := by
+  have h : (evaluate z).comp (rebind theta) =
+      evaluate (fun x => evaluate z (theta x)) := by
+    apply FreeMagma.hom_ext
+    funext a
+    cases a <;> rfl
+  exact congrArg (fun f : Term X →ₙ* Source => f t) h
+
+/-- Enumerate precisely the unbound original variables, without dropping
+unused coordinates from the supplied finite presentation. -/
+def unboundVariables {X : Type} (p : Presentation X) (S : Lambda.SubstInfo) :
+    List (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Y p S) :=
+  p.enumeration.attach.filterMap (fun x =>
+    if h : p.code x.val ∉ S.subst.keys then some ⟨x.val, h⟩ else none)
+
+private theorem unbound_complete {X : Type} (p : Presentation X) (S : Lambda.SubstInfo)
+    (x : NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Y p S) : x ∈ unboundVariables p S := by
+  apply List.mem_filterMap.mpr
+  refine ⟨⟨x.val, p.complete x.val⟩, by simp, ?_⟩
+  dsimp only
+  have hx : p.code x.val ∉ S.subst.keys := x.property
+  exact dite_eq_left hx
+
+/-- The free carrier is a subset of the original finite presentation.
+There are no positive equations or shape restrictions on its valuations. -/
+structure RowOutput (X : Type) where
+  free : Set X
+  enumeration : List free
+  complete : ∀ x, x ∈ enumeration
+  theta : X → Term free
+  delta : Equations free
+
+def outputHolds {X : Type} (o : RowOutput X) (v : X → Source) : Prop :=
+  ∃ z : o.free → Source, (∀ x, evaluate z (o.theta x) = v x) ∧ Diseq o.delta z
+
+def eliminateRows {X : Type} (p : Presentation X) (t : Term X)
+    (rs : List RawRow) (extra : SignedConstraints X) : Option (RowOutput X) :=
+  match compileRows t rs with
+  | none => none
+  | some rows =>
+      let c := mergeConstraints rows extra
+      match h : (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.encodeEquations p c.1).unify Lambda.SubstInfo.empty with
+      | .error _ => none
+      | .ok S => some {
+          free := fun x => x ∉ NativeGroundSolutionSpace.D p S
+          enumeration := unboundVariables p S
+          complete := unbound_complete p S
+          theta := NativeGroundSolutionSpace.sigma p c.1 S h
+          delta := c.2.map (fun d =>
+            (rebind (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.sigma p c.1 S h) d.1,
+             rebind (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.sigma p c.1 S h) d.2)) }
+
+private theorem mgu_output_exact {X : Type} (p : Presentation X)
+    (c : SignedConstraints X) (S : Lambda.SubstInfo)
+    (h : (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.encodeEquations p c.1).unify Lambda.SubstInfo.empty = .ok S)
+    (v : X → Source) :
+    constraintsHold c v ↔ outputHolds {
+      free := fun x => x ∉ NativeGroundSolutionSpace.D p S
+      enumeration := unboundVariables p S
+      complete := unbound_complete p S
+      theta := NativeGroundSolutionSpace.sigma p c.1 S h
+      delta := c.2.map (fun d =>
+        (rebind (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.sigma p c.1 S h) d.1,
+         rebind (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.sigma p c.1 S h) d.2)) } v := by
+  have transport (z : NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Y p S → Source) :
+      Diseq (c.2.map (fun d =>
+        (rebind (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.sigma p c.1 S h) d.1,
+         rebind (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.sigma p c.1 S h) d.2))) z ↔
+      Diseq c.2 (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Ext p c.1 S h z) := by
+    simp only [Diseq, List.mem_map, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂,
+      rebind_evaluate]
+    rfl
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨sol, neg⟩
+    refine ⟨NativeGroundSolutionSpace.restriction p S v, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · exact congrFun (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Ext_restriction p c.1 S h v sol)
+    · apply (transport _).mpr
+      rw [NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Ext_restriction p c.1 S h v sol]
+      exact neg
+  · rintro ⟨z, hz, neg⟩
+    have same : NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Ext p c.1 S h z = v := funext hz
+    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
+    · rw [← same]
+      exact NativeGroundSolutionSpace.Ext_sol p c.1 S h z
+    · rw [← same]
+      exact (transport z).mp neg
+
+/-- All raw rows are eliminated on one total original variable family.
+A successful output may have an empty disequality domain. -/
+private theorem symbolic_rows_elimination {X : Type} (p : Presentation X) (t : Term X)
+    (rs : List RawRow) (extra : SignedConstraints X) (v : X → Source) :
+    ((∀ r ∈ rs, symbolicRecord r.1 t v = r.2) ∧ constraintsHold extra v) ↔
+      ∃ o, eliminateRows p t rs extra = some o ∧ outputHolds o v := by
+  rw [compile_rows_exact]
+  unfold eliminateRows
+  cases hc : compileRows t rs with
+  | none => simp
+  | some rows =>
+      simp only [Option.some.injEq, exists_eq_left']
+      rw [← constraints_merge_exact]
+      split
+      · rename_i e hu
+        have no : ¬ constraintsHold (mergeConstraints rows extra) v := by
+          intro h
+          obtain ⟨S, hs⟩ := NativeGroundSolutionSpace.native_complete p
+            (mergeConstraints rows extra).1 v h.1
+          rw [hu] at hs
+          cases hs
+        simp [no]
+      · rename_i S hu
+        simpa only [Option.some.injEq, exists_eq_left'] using
+          mgu_output_exact p (mergeConstraints rows extra) S hu v
+
+
+/-- The same executable output describes arbitrary symbolic rows and the
+actual rows of every sufficiently deep original prefix pattern. -/
+theorem complete_row_elimination {X : Type} (p : Presentation X) (t : Term X)
+    (rs : List RawRow) (extra : SignedConstraints X) (v : X → Source) :
+    (((∀ r ∈ rs, symbolicRecord r.1 t v = r.2) ∧ constraintsHold extra v) ↔
+      ∃ o, eliminateRows p t rs extra = some o ∧ outputHolds o v) ∧
+    ∀ (d : Nat) (pat : NativeDepthPatterns.Pattern d)
+      (name : NativeDepthPatterns.Frontier pat → X),
+      t = NativeHistoryCells.patternTerm pat name →
+      (∀ r ∈ rs, CutPrefixFree r.1) →
+      (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ q ∈ r.1, q.length < d) →
+      (((∀ r ∈ rs, literalRecord r.1 (NativeDepthPatterns.fill pat (v ∘ name)) = r.2) ∧
+        constraintsHold extra v) ↔
+        ∃ o, eliminateRows p t rs extra = some o ∧ outputHolds o v) := by
+  have hs := symbolic_rows_elimination p t rs extra v
+  refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
+  intro d pat name ht freecuts bound
+  have deep : DeepAt d [] t := by
+    rw [ht]
+    exact NativeHistoryCells.pattern_deep d d pat name [] (by simp)
+  have filled : evaluate v t = NativeDepthPatterns.fill pat (v ∘ name) := by
+    rw [ht]
+    exact NativeHistoryCells.pattern_evaluate d pat name v
+  have rows :
+      (∀ r ∈ rs, literalRecord r.1 (NativeDepthPatterns.fill pat (v ∘ name)) = r.2) ↔
+      (∀ r ∈ rs, symbolicRecord r.1 t v = r.2) := by
+    constructor <;> intro h r hr
+    · have he := (symbolic_recut_exact d r.1 (freecuts r hr) (bound r hr) t deep v).2.2.2
+      rw [filled] at he
+      exact he.symm.trans (h r hr)
+    · have he := (symbolic_recut_exact d r.1 (freecuts r hr) (bound r hr) t deep v).2.2.2
+      rw [filled] at he
+      exact he.trans (h r hr)
+  exact (and_congr rows Iff.rfl).trans hs
+
+end D5.S3.Arith.FibonacciAtomic.Observer.Constructor.NativeSymbolicRowElimination

+import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.CofilteredSystem
+import Mathlib.Data.PNat.Basic
+import Mathlib.Data.Rat.Lemmas
+import Mathlib.Tactic

+open CategoryTheory Opposite

+namespace D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Coding.PrimitiveLifts.FiniteRootFiberCoherence

+universe u

+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

+private structure PosDegree where
+  val : ℕ+
+
+private instance : LE PosDegree := ⟨fun a b => a.val ∣ b.val⟩
+
+private instance : Preorder PosDegree where
+  le_refl a := dvd_refl a.val
+  le_trans a b c := dvd_trans
+
+private instance : IsDirectedOrder PosDegree where
+  directed a b := by
+    refine ⟨⟨a.val * b.val⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · exact dvd_mul_right _ _
+    · exact dvd_mul_left _ _
+
+private def rootFiber {H : Type u} [Group H] (h : H) (n : PosDegree) :=
+  {b : H // b ^ n.val.val = h}
+
+private def quotient (m n : PosDegree) (hnm : n ≤ m) : ℕ+ :=
+  PNat.divExact m.val n.val
+
+private theorem quotient_spec {m n : PosDegree} (hnm : n ≤ m) :
+    n.val * quotient m n hnm = m.val := by
+  exact PNat.mul_div_exact hnm
+
+private theorem quotient_comp {n m k : PosDegree} (hnm : n ≤ m) (hkm : m ≤ k) :
+    quotient k m hkm * quotient m n hnm = quotient k n (le_trans hnm hkm) := by
+  apply PNat.eq
+  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel n.val.pos
+  have hp : n.val * (quotient k m hkm * quotient m n hnm) =
+      n.val * quotient k n (le_trans hnm hkm) := by
+    calc
+      n.val * (quotient k m hkm * quotient m n hnm) =
+          (n.val * quotient m n hnm) * quotient k m hkm := by ac_rfl
+      _ = m.val * quotient k m hkm := by rw [quotient_spec hnm]
+      _ = k.val := quotient_spec hkm
+      _ = n.val * quotient k n (le_trans hnm hkm) :=
+        (quotient_spec (le_trans hnm hkm)).symm
+  simpa using congrArg PNat.val hp
+
+private theorem quotient_self (n : PosDegree) : quotient n n (le_refl n) = 1 := by
+  apply PNat.eq
+  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel n.val.pos
+  have hp : n.val * quotient n n (le_refl n) = n.val * (1 : ℕ+) := by
+    simpa using quotient_spec (le_refl n)
+  simpa using congrArg PNat.val hp
+
+private def rootMap {H : Type u} [Group H] {h : H} {m n : PosDegree}
+    (hnm : n ≤ m) (x : rootFiber h m) : rootFiber h n :=
+  ⟨x.1 ^ (quotient m n hnm).val, by
+    rw [← pow_mul]
+    have hpow : n.val.val * (quotient m n hnm).val = m.val.val := by
+      simpa using congrArg PNat.val (quotient_spec hnm)
+    have hpow' : (quotient m n hnm).val * n.val.val = m.val.val := by
+      rw [Nat.mul_comm]
+      exact hpow
+    rw [hpow', x.2]⟩
+
+private def rootSystem {H : Type u} [Group H] (h : H) : PosDegreeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u where
+  obj n := rootFiber h n.unop
+  map f := ↾(fun x => rootMap (h := h) (leOfHom f.unop) x)
+  map_id n := by
+    apply TypeCat.Hom.ext
+    apply TypeCat.Fun.ext
+    funext x
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    change (x.1 ^ (quotient n.unop n.unop (le_refl n.unop)).val : H) = x.1
+    rw [quotient_self]
+    exact pow_one x.1
+  map_comp {X Y Z} f g := by
+    apply TypeCat.Hom.ext
+    apply TypeCat.Fun.ext
+    funext x
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    change x.1 ^ (quotient X.unop Z.unop _).val =
+      (x.1 ^ (quotient X.unop Y.unop _).val) ^
+        (quotient Y.unop Z.unop _).val
+    rw [← pow_mul]
+    have hxy : Y.unop ≤ X.unop := leOfHom f.unop
+    have hyz : Z.unop ≤ Y.unop := leOfHom g.unop
+    have hxz : Z.unop ≤ X.unop := le_trans hyz hxy
+    have hqnat :
+        (quotient X.unop Y.unop hxy).val * (quotient Y.unop Z.unop hyz).val =
+          (quotient X.unop Z.unop hxz).val := by
+      exact congrArg PNat.val (quotient_comp hyz hxy)
+    rw [hqnat]
+
+private theorem coherent_roots {H : Type u} [Group H] (h : H)
+    (hfin : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Finite {b : H // b ^ n = h})
+    (hex : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ b : H, b ^ n = h) :
+    ∃ (b : ∀ n : PosDegree, H),
+      (∀ n : PosDegree, (b n) ^ n.val.val = h) ∧
+        ∀ {n m : PosDegree} (hnm : n ≤ m),
+          (b m) ^ (quotient m n hnm).val = b n := by
+  let F := rootSystem h
+  have hFfin : ∀ n : PosDegreeᵒᵖ, Finite (F.obj n) := by
+    intro n
+    dsimp [F, rootSystem, rootFiber]
+    exact hfin n.unop.val.val n.unop.val.pos
+  have hFne : ∀ n : PosDegreeᵒᵖ, Nonempty (F.obj n) := by
+    intro n
+    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hex n.unop.val.val n.unop.val.pos
+    dsimp [F, rootSystem, rootFiber]
+    exact ⟨⟨b, hb⟩⟩
+  letI : ∀ n : PosDegreeᵒᵖ, Finite (F.obj n) := hFfin
+  letI : ∀ n : PosDegreeᵒᵖ, Nonempty (F.obj n) := hFne
+  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := nonempty_sections_of_finite_inverse_system F
+  let chosen : ∀ n : PosDegree, rootFiber h n := fun n => s (op n)
+  refine ⟨fun n => (chosen n).1, (fun n => (chosen n).2), ?_⟩
+  intro n m hnm
+  have hc := hs ((homOfLE hnm).op)
+  dsimp [F, rootSystem] at hc
+  have hc' : rootMap (h := h) hnm (s (op m)) = s (op n) := by
+    exact hc
+  simpa [chosen, rootMap] using congrArg Subtype.val hc'
+
+private theorem rational_action_of_coherent_roots {H : Type u} [Group H] (h : H)
+    (b : ∀ n : PosDegree, H)
+    (hb : ∀ n : PosDegree, (b n) ^ n.val.val = h)
+    (hcompat : ∀ {m n : PosDegree} (hnm : n ≤ m),
+      (b m) ^ (quotient m n hnm).val = b n) :
+    ∃ φ : Multiplicative ℚ →* H, φ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℚ)) = h := by
+  let degree : ℚ → PosDegree := fun q => ⟨⟨q.den, q.den_pos⟩⟩
+  let common : PosDegree → PosDegree → PosDegree → PosDegree :=
+    fun d e f => ⟨d.val * e.val * f.val⟩
+  have hleft (d e f : PosDegree) : d ≤ common d e f := by
+    change d.val ∣ d.val * e.val * f.val
+    simpa [mul_assoc] using dvd_mul_right d.val (e.val * f.val)
+  have hmid (d e f : PosDegree) : e ≤ common d e f := by
+    change e.val ∣ d.val * e.val * f.val
+    simpa [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using dvd_mul_right e.val (d.val * f.val)
+  have hright (d e f : PosDegree) : f ≤ common d e f := by
+    change f.val ∣ d.val * e.val * f.val
+    simpa [mul_assoc] using dvd_mul_left f.val (d.val * e.val)
+  have qleft (d e f : PosDegree) :
+      quotient (common d e f) d (hleft d e f) = e.val * f.val := by
+    apply PNat.eq
+    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel d.val.pos
+    have hp : d.val * quotient (common d e f) d (hleft d e f) =
+        d.val * (e.val * f.val) := by
+      calc
+        d.val * quotient (common d e f) d (hleft d e f) = (common d e f).val :=
+          quotient_spec (hleft d e f)
+        _ = d.val * (e.val * f.val) := by simp [common]; ac_rfl
+    simpa using congrArg PNat.val hp
+  have qmid (d e f : PosDegree) :
+      quotient (common d e f) e (hmid d e f) = d.val * f.val := by
+    apply PNat.eq
+    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel e.val.pos
+    have hp : e.val * quotient (common d e f) e (hmid d e f) =
+        e.val * (d.val * f.val) := by
+      calc
+        e.val * quotient (common d e f) e (hmid d e f) = (common d e f).val :=
+          quotient_spec (hmid d e f)
+        _ = e.val * (d.val * f.val) := by simp [common]; ac_rfl
+    simpa using congrArg PNat.val hp
+  have qright (d e f : PosDegree) :
+      quotient (common d e f) f (hright d e f) = d.val * e.val := by
+    apply PNat.eq
+    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel f.val.pos
+    have hp : f.val * quotient (common d e f) f (hright d e f) =
+        f.val * (d.val * e.val) := by
+      calc
+        f.val * quotient (common d e f) f (hright d e f) = (common d e f).val :=
+          quotient_spec (hright d e f)
+        _ = f.val * (d.val * e.val) := by simp [common]; ac_rfl
+    simpa using congrArg PNat.val hp
+  let value : ℚ → H := fun q => (b (degree q)) ^ q.num
+  have value_zero : value 0 = 1 := by simp [value, degree]
+  have value_add (q r : ℚ) : value (q + r) = value q * value r := by
+    let d := degree q
+    let e := degree r
+    let f := degree (q + r)
+    let c := common d e f
+    have hqd := hcompat (hleft d e f)
+    have hrd := hcompat (hmid d e f)
+    have hsd := hcompat (hright d e f)
+    have hq : value q = (b c) ^
+        (((e.val.val * f.val.val : ℕ) : ℤ) * q.num) := by
+      dsimp [value, d, e, f, c]
+      rw [← hqd, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
+      rw [qleft]
+      simp [d, e, f, c]
+    have hr : value r = (b c) ^
+        (((d.val.val * f.val.val : ℕ) : ℤ) * r.num) := by
+      dsimp [value, d, e, f, c]
+      rw [← hrd, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
+      rw [qmid]
+      simp [d, e, f, c]
+    have hs : value (q + r) = (b c) ^
+        (((d.val.val * e.val.val : ℕ) : ℤ) * (q + r).num) := by
+      dsimp [value, d, e, f, c]
+      rw [← hsd, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
+      rw [qright]
+      simp [d, e, f, c]
+    rw [hq, hr, hs, ← zpow_add]
+    congr 1
+    have hn := Rat.add_num_den' q r
+    change ((d.val.val * e.val.val : ℕ) : ℤ) * (q + r).num =
+        ((e.val.val * f.val.val : ℕ) : ℤ) * q.num +
+          ((d.val.val * f.val.val : ℕ) : ℤ) * r.num
+    rw [add_mul] at hn
+    simpa [d, e, f, degree, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hn
+  let χ : AddChar ℚ H :=
+    { toFun := value
+      map_zero_eq_one' := value_zero
+      map_add_eq_mul' := value_add }
+  refine ⟨χ.toMonoidHom, ?_⟩
+  simpa [χ, value, degree] using hb (degree 1)
+
+/-- For any group H and fixed h with finite positive-degree root fibers, independent roots
+in every positive degree are equivalent to a monoid homomorphism φ : Multiplicative ℚ →* H
+with φ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℚ)) = h. -/
+theorem finite_root_fibers_rational_coherence {H : Type u} [Group H] (h : H)
+    (hfin : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Finite {b : H // b ^ n = h}) :
+    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ b : H, b ^ n = h) ↔
+      ∃ φ : Multiplicative ℚ →* H, φ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℚ)) = h := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hex
+    obtain ⟨b, hb, hcompat⟩ := coherent_roots h hfin hex
+    exact rational_action_of_coherent_roots h b hb hcompat
+  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩ n hn
+    refine ⟨φ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 / n : ℚ)), ?_⟩
+    have hp := φ.map_pow (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 / n : ℚ)) n
+    have hx : (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 / n : ℚ)) ^ n =
+        Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℚ) := by
+      change Multiplicative.ofAdd (n • (1 / n : ℚ)) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℚ)
+      congr 1
+      norm_num [nsmul_eq_mul, hn.ne']
+    rw [hx, hφ] at hp
+    exact hp.symm
+
+#print axioms finite_root_fibers_rational_coherence
+
+end D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.Coding.PrimitiveLifts.FiniteRootFiberCoherence

+/- GID: D5/S3/Observer/ProbabilisticClosure/TrajectoryLaws/FiniteResiduals/FiniteResidualStopping

+   anchors: []
+   utility: none
+   digest: Recursive joint residuals imply word laws, which exactly characterize finite stopping archives. -/
+
+import D5.S3.Estimation.DecisionRisk.DescentDefectBounds
+import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic
+import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Union
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
+noncomputable section
+attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
+open scoped BigOperators
+open D5.S3.Estimation.DecisionRisk.DescentDefectBounds
+namespace D5.S3.Observer.ProbabilisticClosure.TrajectoryLaws.FiniteResiduals.FiniteResidualStopping
+
+variable {S Y : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype Y]
+
+/-- The joint mass of a label and the equivalence class of a representative. -/
+def classMass (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S)) (R : S → S → Prop)
+    (x : S) (y : Y) (c : S) : ℝ := by
+  classical
+  exact ∑ r, if R r c then K.1 x (y,r) else 0
+
+/-- Constant current observation gives the universal zeroth relation. The previous
+relation is explicitly retained at each successor stage. -/
+def residual (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S)) : ℕ → S → S → Prop
+  | 0, _, _ => True
+  | n+1, x, x' => residual K n x x' ∧
+      ∀ y c, classMass K (residual K n) x y c = classMass K (residual K n) x' y c
+
+/-- Actual emitted-word probabilities, with no hidden class in the archive. -/
+def wordProb (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S)) (x : S) : List Y → ℝ
+  | [] => 1
+  | y :: w => ∑ r, K.1 x (y,r) * wordProb K r w
+
+def TraceEq (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S)) (n : ℕ) (x x' : S) : Prop :=
+  ∀ w : List Y, w.length ≤ n → wordProb K x w = wordProb K x' w
+
+/-- The only control is stopping or taking the unique legal action; branches are
+indexed only by the label actually emitted. -/
+inductive Experiment (Y : Type*) : ℕ → Type _
+  | stop {n : ℕ} : Experiment Y n
+  | step {n : ℕ} : (Y → Experiment Y n) → Experiment Y (n+1)
+
+/-- Chronological execution sums over actual hidden successors, independently of
+word probabilities or residual equivalence. -/
+def archiveProb (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S)) :
+    {n : ℕ} → Experiment Y n → S → List Y → ℝ
+  | _, .stop, _, w => if w = [] then 1 else 0
+  | _, .step _, _, [] => 0
+  | _, .step f, x, y::w => ∑ r, K.1 x (y,r) * archiveProb K (f y) r w
+
+/-- Whether the tree stops for the first time at precisely this recorded word. -/
+def accepts : {n : ℕ} → Experiment Y n → List Y → Prop
+  | _, .stop, w => w = []
+  | _, .step _, [] => False
+  | _, .step f, y::w => accepts (f y) w
+
+/-- All possible archives form a finite prefix-free leaf set. -/
+def leaves [DecidableEq Y] : {n : ℕ} → Experiment Y n → Finset (List Y)
+  | _, .stop => {[]}
+  | _, .step f => Finset.univ.biUnion fun y => (leaves (f y)).image (List.cons y)
+
+/-- Equality of every permitted finite-depth stopped archive law. -/
+def StoppingEq (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S)) (n : ℕ) (x x' : S) : Prop :=
+  ∀ k, k ≤ n → ∀ E : Experiment Y k, ∀ w, archiveProb K E x w = archiveProb K E x' w
+
+private theorem residual_equivalence (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S)) (n : ℕ) :
+    Equivalence (residual K n) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => exact ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => trivial, fun _ _ => trivial⟩
+  | succ n ih =>
+    refine ⟨fun x => ⟨ih.refl x, fun _ _ => rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · intro x x' h
+      exact ⟨ih.symm h.1, fun y c => (h.2 y c).symm⟩
+    · intro x x' x'' h h'
+      exact ⟨ih.trans h.1 h'.1, fun y c => (h.2 y c).trans (h'.2 y c)⟩
+
+/-- A class-constant continuation can be integrated using only class masses. -/
+private theorem integrate_classes (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S))
+    (R : S → S → Prop) (hR : Equivalence R) (x x' : S) (y : Y)
+    (h : ∀ c, classMass K R x y c = classMass K R x' y c)
+    (g : S → ℝ) (hg : ∀ a b, R a b → g a = g b) :
+    (∑ r, K.1 x (y,r) * g r) = ∑ r, K.1 x' (y,r) * g r := by
+  classical
+  let setoid : Setoid S := ⟨R,hR⟩
+  letI := setoid
+  conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_partition setoid]
+  conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_partition setoid]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro q _
+  obtain ⟨c,rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep q
+  have group (a : S) :
+      (∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun r => (Quotient.mk setoid r) = Quotient.mk setoid c),
+        K.1 a (y,r) * g r) = classMass K R a y c * g c := by
+    rw [classMass, Finset.sum_mul]
+    simp only [Finset.sum_filter]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro r _
+    by_cases hr : R r c
+    · rw [if_pos (Quotient.sound hr), if_pos hr, hg r c hr]
+    · rw [if_neg (fun he => hr (Quotient.exact he)), if_neg hr, zero_mul]
+  rw [group,group,h c]
+
+/-- Every recursive residual preserves all actual words through its horizon. -/
+theorem residual_sound (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S)) (n : ℕ) (x x' : S)
+    (h : residual K n x x') : TraceEq K n x x' := by
+  induction n generalizing x x' with
+  | zero =>
+    intro w hw
+    cases w with
+    | nil => rfl
+    | cons y w => simp at hw
+  | succ n ih =>
+    intro w hw
+    cases w with
+    | nil => rfl
+    | cons y w =>
+      exact integrate_classes K (residual K n) (residual_equivalence K n) x x' y
+        (h.2 y) (fun r => wordProb K r w)
+        (fun a b hab => ih a b hab w (by simpa using hw))
+
+private theorem archive_word (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S))
+    {n : ℕ} (E : Experiment Y n) (x : S) (w : List Y) :
+    archiveProb K E x w = if accepts E w then wordProb K x w else 0 := by
+  classical
+  induction E generalizing x w with
+  | stop => cases w <;> simp [archiveProb, accepts, wordProb]
+  | step f ih =>
+    cases w with
+    | nil => simp [archiveProb, accepts]
+    | cons y w =>
+      simp only [archiveProb, accepts, ih]
+      by_cases h : accepts (f y) w <;> simp [h, wordProb]
+
+omit [Fintype Y] in
+private theorem accepts_length {n : ℕ} (E : Experiment Y n) (w : List Y)
+    (h : accepts E w) : w.length ≤ n := by
+  induction E generalizing w with
+  | stop =>
+    have hw : w = [] := h
+    subst w
+    exact Nat.zero_le _
+  | step f ih =>
+    cases w with
+    | nil => exact False.elim h
+    | cons y w => exact Nat.succ_le_succ (ih y w h)
+
+private def full : (k : ℕ) → Experiment Y k
+  | 0 => .stop
+  | k+1 => .step (fun _ => full k)
+
+omit [Fintype Y] in
+private theorem full_accepts (w : List Y) : accepts (full w.length) w := by
+  induction w with
+  | nil => rfl
+  | cons y w ih => exact ih
+
+/-- Equality of actual bounded word laws is exactly equality of the independently
+executed stopping trees. Immediate stopping, empty words and null branches are included. -/
+theorem trace_iff_stopping (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S)) (n : ℕ) (x x' : S) :
+    TraceEq K n x x' ↔ StoppingEq K n x x' := by
+  classical
+  constructor
+  · intro h k hk E w
+    rw [archive_word, archive_word]
+    by_cases ha : accepts E w
+    · rw [if_pos ha, if_pos ha, h w ((accepts_length E w ha).trans hk)]
+    · rw [if_neg ha, if_neg ha]
+  · intro h w hw
+    have hh := h w.length hw (full w.length) w
+    simpa only [archive_word, if_pos (full_accepts w)] using hh
+
+private theorem leaf_sum_step [DecidableEq Y] {n : ℕ} (f : Y → Experiment Y n)
+    (g : List Y → ℝ) :
+    (∑ w ∈ leaves (.step f), g w) = ∑ y, ∑ w ∈ leaves (f y), g (y::w) := by
+  rw [leaves, Finset.sum_biUnion]
+  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro y _
+    exact Finset.sum_image (fun _ _ _ _ h => (List.cons.inj h).2)
+  · intro y _ y' _ hne
+    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
+    intro w hw hw'
+    obtain ⟨v,_,hv⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
+    obtain ⟨v',_,hv'⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw'
+    exact hne (List.cons.inj (hv.trans hv'.symm)).1
+
+private theorem archive_nonneg (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S))
+    {n : ℕ} (E : Experiment Y n) (x : S) (w : List Y) : 0 ≤ archiveProb K E x w := by
+  induction E generalizing x w with
+  | stop => dsimp [archiveProb]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
+  | step f ih =>
+    cases w with
+    | nil => exact le_rfl
+    | cons y w => exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun r _ => mul_nonneg (K.2.1 _ _) (ih y r w))
+
+private theorem archive_total [DecidableEq Y] (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S))
+    {n : ℕ} (E : Experiment Y n) (x : S) :
+    (∑ w ∈ leaves E, archiveProb K E x w) = 1 := by
+  induction E generalizing x with
+  | stop => simp [leaves,archiveProb]
+  | step f ih =>
+    rw [leaf_sum_step]
+    simp only [archiveProb]
+    have regroup (y : Y) :
+        (∑ w ∈ leaves (f y), ∑ r, K.1 x (y,r) * archiveProb K (f y) r w) =
+          ∑ r, K.1 x (y,r) := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ih, mul_one]
+    simp_rw [regroup]
+    simpa only [Fintype.sum_prod_type] using K.2.2 x
+
+/-- Chronological execution is a nonnegative probability law supported on finite
+archives of length at most the declared depth. -/
+theorem archive_probability_law (K : FiniteMarkovKernel S (Y × S))
+    {n : ℕ} (E : Experiment Y n) (x : S) :
+    (∀ w, 0 ≤ archiveProb K E x w) ∧
+    (∀ w, n < w.length → archiveProb K E x w = 0) ∧
+    (letI := Classical.decEq Y; ∑ w ∈ leaves E, archiveProb K E x w) = 1 := by
+  classical
+  refine ⟨archive_nonneg K E x, ?_, archive_total K E x⟩
+  intro w hw
+  rw [archive_word]
+  exact if_neg (fun ha => (Nat.not_le_of_lt hw) (accepts_length E w ha))
+
+#print axioms residual_sound
+#print axioms trace_iff_stopping
+#print axioms archive_probability_law
+
+end D5.S3.Observer.ProbabilisticClosure.TrajectoryLaws.FiniteResiduals.FiniteResidualStopping

+/- GID: D5/S3/Observer/ProbabilisticClosure/TrajectoryLaws/FiniteResiduals/SixStateResidualSeparation

+   digest: One six-state kernel separates every stopping archive from the stable residual and defeats almost-sure label updates. -/

+import D5.S3.Observer.ProbabilisticClosure.TrajectoryLaws.FiniteResiduals.FiniteResidualStopping
+import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
+import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
+import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
+set_option maxRecDepth 3000
+set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
+noncomputable section
+open scoped BigOperators
+open D5.S3.Estimation.DecisionRisk.DescentDefectBounds
+open D5.S3.Observer.ProbabilisticClosure.TrajectoryLaws.FiniteResiduals.FiniteResidualStopping
+namespace D5.S3.Observer.ProbabilisticClosure.TrajectoryLaws.FiniteResiduals.SixStateResidualSeparation
+
+/-- Indices 0,1,2,3,4,5 denote s,t,u,v,w,z, respectively. -/
+def row (x : Fin 6) (e : Bool × Fin 6) : ℝ :=
+  match x.val, e.1, e.2.val with
+  | 0, false, 2 => 1/2
+  | 0, false, 3 => 1/2
+  | 1, false, 4 => 1
+  | 2, false, 5 => 1
+  | 3, true, 5 => 1
+  | 4, false, 5 => 1/2
+  | 4, true, 5 => 1/2
+  | 5, false, 5 => 1
+  | _, _, _ => 0
+
+private theorem row_stochastic : IsRowStochastic row := by
+  constructor
+  · intro x e
+    rcases e with ⟨y,r⟩
+    fin_cases x <;> cases y <;> fin_cases r <;> norm_num [row]
+  · intro x
+    fin_cases x <;> norm_num [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_bool, Fin.sum_univ_succ, row]
+
+def kernel : FiniteMarkovKernel (Fin 6) (Bool × Fin 6) := ⟨row,row_stochastic⟩
+
+/-- The first three classes are {s,t,u,z}, {v}, {w}. -/
+def firstClass (x : Fin 6) : Fin 3 :=
+  if x = 3 then 1 else if x = 4 then 2 else 0
+
+/-- The stable five classes are {s}, {t}, {u,z}, {v}, {w}. -/
+def stableClass (x : Fin 6) : Fin 5 :=
+  match x.val with
+  | 0 => 0
+  | 1 => 1
+  | 2 => 2
+  | 3 => 3
+  | 4 => 4
+  | _ => 2
+
+private theorem first_partition (x x' : Fin 6) :
+    residual kernel 1 x x' ↔ firstClass x = firstClass x' := by
+  fin_cases x <;> fin_cases x' <;>
+    norm_num [FiniteResidualStopping.residual, classMass, kernel, row, firstClass, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
+      Fin.forall_fin_succ, Bool.forall_bool]
+
+private theorem second_partition (x x' : Fin 6) :
+    residual kernel 2 x x' ↔ stableClass x = stableClass x' := by
+  change (residual kernel 1 x x' ∧ ∀ y c,
+    classMass kernel (residual kernel 1) x y c =
+    classMass kernel (residual kernel 1) x' y c) ↔ _
+  simp only [first_partition, classMass]
+  fin_cases x <;> fin_cases x' <;>
+    norm_num [kernel, row, firstClass, stableClass, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
+      Fin.forall_fin_succ, Bool.forall_bool]
+
+private theorem third_partition : residual kernel 3 = residual kernel 2 := by
+  funext x x'
+  apply propext
+  change (residual kernel 2 x x' ∧ ∀ y c,
+    classMass kernel (residual kernel 2) x y c =
+    classMass kernel (residual kernel 2) x' y c) ↔ _
+  simp only [second_partition, classMass]
+  fin_cases x <;> fin_cases x' <;>
+    norm_num [kernel, row, stableClass, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
+      Fin.forall_fin_succ, Bool.forall_bool]
+
+private theorem plateau (n : ℕ) : residual kernel (n+2) = residual kernel 2 := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih =>
+    change (fun x x' => residual kernel (n+2) x x' ∧ ∀ y c,
+      classMass kernel (residual kernel (n+2)) x y c =
+      classMass kernel (residual kernel (n+2)) x' y c) = _
+    rw [ih]
+    exact third_partition
+
+private theorem limit_partition (x x' : Fin 6) :
+    (∀ n, residual kernel n x x') ↔ stableClass x = stableClass x' := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    exact (second_partition x x').mp (h 2)
+  · intro h n
+    have h2 := (second_partition x x').mpr h
+    rcases n with _ | n
+    · trivial
+    rcases n with _ | n
+    · exact h2.1
+    · rw [plateau n]
+      exact h2
+
+/-- z is an ordinary absorbing state, so precisely all-zero words have mass one. -/
+private theorem absorbing_word (w : List Bool) :
+    wordProb kernel 5 w = if w.all (fun b => !b) then 1 else 0 := by
+  induction w with
+  | nil => simp [wordProb]
+  | cons y w ih =>
+    have hz : wordProb ⟨row,row_stochastic⟩ 5 w =
+        (if w.all (fun b => !b) then 1 else 0) := ih
+    cases y <;> simp [wordProb,kernel,row,Fin.sum_univ_succ,hz]
+
+/-- The common law has first bit zero, a fair second bit and zero thereafter. -/
+def profile : List Bool → ℝ
+  | [] => 1
+  | [false] => 1
+  | false :: _ :: w => (1/2) * (if w.all (fun b => !b) then 1 else 0)
+  | _ => 0
+
+private theorem common_word (w : List Bool) :
+    wordProb kernel 0 w = profile w ∧ wordProb kernel 1 w = profile w := by
+  cases w with
+  | nil => simp [wordProb,profile]
+  | cons y w =>
+    cases w with
+    | nil => cases y <;> norm_num [wordProb,kernel,row,Fin.sum_univ_succ,profile]
+    | cons b w =>
+      have hz : wordProb ⟨row,row_stochastic⟩ 5 w =
+          (if w.all (fun b => !b) then 1 else 0) := absorbing_word w
+      cases y <;> cases b <;>
+        simp [wordProb,kernel,row,Fin.sum_univ_succ,profile,hz]
+
+/-- Canonical representatives of precisely the five stable classes. -/
+def representative (q : Fin 5) : Fin 6 := ⟨q.val, by omega⟩
+
+def quotientRow (q : Fin 5) (e : Bool × Fin 5) : ℝ :=
+  ∑ r : Fin 6, if stableClass r = e.2 then row (representative q) (e.1,r) else 0
+
+private theorem quotient_reproduces (x : Fin 6) (y : Bool) (q : Fin 5) :
+    quotientRow (stableClass x) (y,q) =
+      ∑ r : Fin 6, if stableClass r = q then row x (y,r) else 0 := by
+  fin_cases x <;> cases y <;> fin_cases q <;>
+    norm_num [quotientRow,stableClass,representative,row,Fin.sum_univ_succ]
+
+private theorem quotient_stochastic : IsRowStochastic quotientRow := by
+  constructor
+  · intro q e
+    change 0 ≤ ∑ r : Fin 6, if stableClass r = e.2 then row (representative q) (e.1,r) else 0
+    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
+    intro r _
+    split_ifs <;> first | exact row_stochastic.1 _ _ | exact le_rfl
+  · intro q
+    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,quotientRow]
+    have regroup (y : Bool) :
+        (∑ d : Fin 5, ∑ r : Fin 6, if stableClass r = d then row (representative q) (y,r) else 0) =
+        ∑ r : Fin 6, row (representative q) (y,r) := by
+      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+      simp
+    simp_rw [regroup]
+    simpa only [Fintype.sum_prod_type] using row_stochastic.2 (representative q)
+
+/-- The quotient is exactly A-infinity and carries the representative-independent
+normalized joint label/successor-class kernel of this same six-state process. -/
+def StochasticQuotient : Prop :=
+  (∀ x x', stableClass x = stableClass x' ↔ ∀ n, residual kernel n x x') ∧
+  ∃ Q : FiniteMarkovKernel (Fin 5) (Bool × Fin 5), ∀ x y q,
+    Q.1 (stableClass x) (y,q) =
+      ∑ r : Fin 6, if stableClass r = q then row x (y,r) else 0
+
+private theorem stochastic_quotient : StochasticQuotient :=
+  ⟨fun x x' => (limit_partition x x').symm,
+    ⟨⟨quotientRow,quotient_stochastic⟩,quotient_reproduces⟩⟩
+
+/-- Actual one-step failure probability, without discarding any successful branch. -/
+def updateFailure (update : Fin 5 → Bool → Fin 5) (x : Fin 6) : ℝ :=
+  ∑ e : Bool × Fin 6,
+    if stableClass e.2 = update (stableClass x) e.1 then 0 else row x e
+
+private theorem positive_update_failure (update : Fin 5 → Bool → Fin 5) :
+    1/2 ≤ updateFailure update 0 := by
+  have hne : ¬ (stableClass 2 = update (stableClass 0) false ∧
+      stableClass 3 = update (stableClass 0) false) := by
+    rintro ⟨h,h'⟩
+    have hh := h.trans h'.symm
+    norm_num [stableClass] at hh
+  simp only [updateFailure,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Fintype.sum_bool,Fin.sum_univ_succ]
+  norm_num [row,stableClass] at hne ⊢
+  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> norm_num
+
+/-- Complete classifications, permanent plateau, actual archive equality and the
+stochastic quotient and positive update obstruction of one and the same kernel. -/
+theorem counterkernel_facts :
+    (∀ x x', residual kernel 1 x x' ↔ firstClass x = firstClass x') ∧
+    (∀ x x', residual kernel 2 x x' ↔ stableClass x = stableClass x') ∧
+    (∀ n, residual kernel (n+2) = residual kernel 2) ∧
+    (∀ x x', (∀ n, residual kernel n x x') ↔ stableClass x = stableClass x') ∧
+    (∀ w, wordProb kernel 0 w = profile w ∧ wordProb kernel 1 w = profile w) ∧
+    (∀ n, StoppingEq kernel n 0 1) ∧
+    residual kernel 1 0 1 ∧ ¬ residual kernel 2 0 1 ∧
+    ¬ (∀ n, residual kernel n 0 1) ∧ StochasticQuotient ∧
+    (∀ update, 1/2 ≤ updateFailure update 0) := by
+  refine ⟨first_partition,second_partition,plateau,limit_partition,common_word,?_,?_,?_,?_,
+    stochastic_quotient,positive_update_failure⟩
+  · intro n
+    apply (trace_iff_stopping kernel n 0 1).mp
+    intro w _
+    exact (common_word w).1.trans (common_word w).2.symm
+  · exact (first_partition 0 1).mpr (by decide)
+  · intro h
+    have hh := (second_partition 0 1).mp h
+    norm_num [stableClass] at hh
+  · intro h
+    have hh := (second_partition 0 1).mp (h 2)
+    norm_num [stableClass] at hh
+
+/-- The two withdrawn assertions, restricted to this very process: all-depth
+stopping equality implies residual equality; and a stochastic residual quotient
+admits a label-determined update with zero actual failure probability. -/
+def claim : Prop :=
+  (∀ x x' : Fin 6, (∀ n, StoppingEq kernel n x x') → ∀ n, residual kernel n x x') ∨
+  (StochasticQuotient → ∃ update : Fin 5 → Bool → Fin 5,
+    ∀ x, updateFailure update x = 0)
+
+/-- Each disjunct fails for the same normalized kernel. -/
+theorem result : ¬ claim := by
+  intro h
+  obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,_,hs,_,hsecond,_,hq,hfailure⟩ := counterkernel_facts
+  rcases h with h | h
+  · exact hsecond (h 0 1 hs 2)
+  · obtain ⟨update,hu⟩ := h hq
+    have hf := hfailure update
+    rw [hu 0] at hf
+    norm_num at hf
+
+#print axioms counterkernel_facts
+#print axioms result
+end D5.S3.Observer.ProbabilisticClosure.TrajectoryLaws.FiniteResiduals.SixStateResidualSeparation

+## Verified locator
+
+Source: https://oeis.org/A397594
+
+DOI: null. The source is OEIS A397594, revision 15; it has no arXiv identifier or pagination.
+
+## Source statement
+
+The NAME field reads:
+
+> G.f. A(x) such that the sum of the first n coefficients in A(x/n)^n equals 4^(n-1) for n >= 1.
+
+The FORMULA field reads:
+
+> G.f. A(x) = Sum_{n>=0} a(n)*x^n has the following properties.
+> (1) 4^(n-1) = Sum_{k=0..n-1} [x^k] A(x/n)^n for n >= 1.
+> (2) (4*n)^(n-1) = [x^(n-1)] A(x)^n / (1 - n*x) for n >= 1.
+
+The COMMENTS field reads:
+
+> Conjecture: for n > 3, a(n) is odd iff n is of the form 2^k-1 or 2^k+1 (k > 1).
+
+The offset is zero and a(0)=1. The formal series has integer coefficients;
+its rational rescaling is `PowerSeries.rescale ((m : ℚ)⁻¹)
+(A.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))`. The first m coefficients are those at
+indices 0 through m−1. Powers are ordinary formal-series multiplication.
+The quantified claim includes existence of an integer source series and
+the parity equivalence for every integer series satisfying (1).
+
+## Scope
+
+Denominator clearing connects (1) and (2). Integer triangular normalization
+gives forcing 4^n(n+1)^(n−1) in positive degree n. Coefficientwise iteration
+constructs an integer source, and reduction modulo two identifies its
+coefficients with the homogeneous dyadic-support solution. The statements
+for the related reversion series B, arbitrary even parameters, full triangle
+integrality, positivity and asymptotics are outside this result.
+
+The finite arithmetic check is in `the-omega-institute/trureturing-experiments`,
+commit `b2b8f61f913caa4dbe8eace3d5ab8dae15cd5225`, at
+`docs/reports/quadrupled-row-dyadic-parity/check.py`, SHA-256
+`665de37ae789c10df0fd0615fd2967a95ca76e3da0997563f2252547c03a51ba`.
+Running `python3 docs/reports/quadrupled-row-dyadic-parity/check.py` exits 0
+with `ALL_CHECKS_OK`: source coefficients agree through degree 24, formula
+(1) holds through n=39, formula (2) holds through n=100, and the odd indices
+from 4 through 100 are 5, 7, 9, 15, 17, 31, 33, 63 and 65. This finite check
+is separate from the all-index theorem.
+
+The literature screen is the bounded screen recorded in issue #22490.
+Its completeness is ASSUMED-UNVERIFIED: OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar were
+rate-limited, and the broad Crossref screen and two classical background
+works do not establish absence of an earlier settlement.

+**Theorem 4.3 (complete original-source signed image strata).** Fix the
+input of Definition 4.1 and any complete finite row label $r$ at $Q$.
+One can construct finitely many source templates $U_{r,b}$ and predicates
+
+$$
+C_{r,b}(\mathbf n,\mathbf z)
+=P_{r,b}(\mathbf n)\land\Delta_{r,b}(\mathbf n,\mathbf z)
+\tag{NIC.19}
+$$
+
+of the form in Theorem 3.3 such that
+
+$$
+D_r:=\{u\in D:R_Q(u)=r\}
+=\bigcup_b\{U_{r,b}(\mathbf n,\mathbf z):C_{r,b}(\mathbf n,\mathbf z)\}.
+\tag{NIC.20}
+$$
+
+Every produced source satisfies all retained records with both guards,
+the entire old row and exactly the finite row label $r$. Conversely
+every original $u\in D_r$ is reconstructed as that same source.
+
+Proof. Apply the finite fixed-navigation decomposition of [NSF, Lemma
+5.1][NSF] to the entire predicate in (NIC.17) and $R_Q(u)=r$. Here are
+the concrete data preserved by that application. Choose a finite
+original prefix depth strictly beyond all finitely listed cut positions
+and record endpoint lengths. Enumerate its finite native prefix
+patterns, with independent frontier variables at its reached boundary.
+A source has its actual pattern and actual frontier subtrees; filling
+these returns that very source. Repeated references to the source use
+the same pattern and variables, not independent copies.
+
+At each fixed epoch and endpoint, navigation through the transformed
+pattern either yields a native expression in those frontiers, yields a
+subtree of the explicitly transformed early ground leaf, or is absent.
+No requested endpoint enters an unspecified frontier, because its
+address is shorter than the chosen original depth. Fixed powers preserve
+original branch nodes and expand early leaves by explicitly finite trees.
+Thus guards and literal replies are decided exactly in each case. An
+absent endpoint rejects either signed record, and a reached pair retains
+its entire native equality or disequality. Repetition retains the same
+expression wherever that endpoint is used.
+

+Each surviving case therefore has a finite native source term
+$W(\mathbf x)$ and a Boolean native formula $\Phi(\mathbf x)$, with
+both directions just described. Keep every frontier and definitional
+auxiliary in its declared tuple. Convert $\Phi$ to finite signed
+conjunctions and apply Theorems 3.2–3.3. Substitute their whole-tuple
+image into $W$. The result is a mixed source template: fixed native
+powers distribute through pairs, add to atomic ranks and combine with
+residual decorations. All negatives in the complete case formula are
+still native tests after this substitution.
+
+For a satisfying parameter tuple, Theorem 3.3 supplies a satisfying
+whole case assignment; filling $W$ gives a finite original source with
+the decided guards, reached sets, masks, all partition bits and records.
+For an original $u\in D_r$, choose its actual prefix and frontiers.
+Theorem 3.3 reconstructs that same assignment, including auxiliaries,
+and hence $W$ reconstructs $u$ itself with its original finite row.
+These prove both inclusions in (NIC.20). All cases and templates are
+finite. $\square$

+**定理 10.1（固定读出的有限取得判据；repo-derived）。** 在定义 9.1–9.2 下，
+对任意给定 $r$，以下三项等价：
+
+1. $r$ 支持有限同源配置取得，允许协议使用全部实际历史。
+2. 每个非空非单元纤维 $B_q=r^{-1}(q)$ 都满足
+
+   $$
+   \bigcap_{C\in B_q}\operatorname{En}(C)\ne\varnothing.
+   \tag{MPC.30}
+   $$
+
+3. 每个 $t\in T$ 的纤维恰为 $\{t\}$，而且对每个不含汇点的非空纤维，
+   都有 (MPC.30)。
+
+满足这些条件时，有一个下一动作只依赖当前读数的协议：在单元纤维立即解码并
+停止，在其余纤维执行预选的共同启用事件。它对初始配置 $C_0$ 至多执行
+$|E|-|C_0|$ 次成功新增。
+
+**证明。** 先证必要性。取入口读数相同的非单元纤维 $B_q$。所有其中配置都可能
+是实际初态，且观察者初始化相同。在第一次成功动作以前，没有别的来源相关输入。
+所以有限的内部计算、重读和停止决定在这些初态上相同。若停止，返回的同一配置
+不可能同时等于两个不同初态；若永不作出动作或停止，则违反有限终止。因此必须
+请求同一个首事件 $e$。对每个 $C\in B_q$ 的安全性要求
+$e\in\operatorname{En}(C)$，得到 (MPC.30)。这一步只约束首个决定，没有假设
+一般协议会丢弃过去的记录。
+
+若第二项成立，含汇点的纤维不能是非单元纤维；不含汇点的单元纤维自身的启用集
+非空，故第三项成立。第三项也立即蕴含第二项。
+
+对充分性，在每个非单元纤维选取一个共同事件 $a(q)$。这一步使用已有的
+[DeterministicSafePolicyExistence，`deterministic_safe_policy_exists_iff`](../../../D5/S3/ConceptDynamics/Agency/DeterministicSafePolicyExistence.lean)
+所表达的安全选择原则：状态取这些纤维中的配置，合法动作取
+$\operatorname{En}(C)$，读出取 $r$ 的限制。该原则本身并非这里的新增结论。
+在单元纤维停止并返回它的唯一配置；否则请求 $a(q)$，成功后读取新的 $r$。
+
+每次所请求事件对实际配置合法，并且严格增加配置大小。因此非负整数
+$|E|-|C|$ 每次减少一，不能无限继续。若协议尚未停止而实际配置已成为汇点，
+第三项又保证其读数纤维是单元纤维，所以下次决定必停止。于是协议在所述次数内
+正确停止，包括零步停止。$\square$
+

+**假设 56.2（原生实现与可证伪合同）。** 若把上述条件数学用于实际量子起源重建，
+须分别供应并保持以下对应。
+
+1. **来源与完整输入。** 每个可用源标签对应何种原生制备及全部原始记录，哪些辅助
+   资料可读，哪些失败质量进入下一步。核中的 delta 提升是向量坐标，不是可无扰动读取的
+   正交源标签服务。源相关记录如被供应，须重算完整输入而非沿用仅由状态决定的界。
+2. **独立组合。** 实际独立重复制备、子系统分解、张量输入和保留系统输出的对应；
+   源嫁接、树地址分解与独立量子乘积分别有自己的合同。
+3. **仪器与比较。** 实现菜单所需的相位校准、任何参考的来源与权限、完整局域菜单、联合拒绝映射及其分支输出，
+   以及后续局域查询。仅符合 (55.2) 的二值效果不足以满足这个合同；
+   只匹配一个终端记录表也不足以认证指定源编码和输出仪器。
+4. **概率与动力学。** Born 标定、允许的相干制备、控制精度、时钟和动力学的物理对应。
+   复局部向量 (45.3) 是模型输入，独立张量制备和 CP／投影仪器也是前提，
+   不从 FIB 语法或信息守恒直觉单独推出。
+
+在这些条件下，可证伪的数学合同分别为：无源相关辅助的二输入转换不可有超过
+(51.2)、(51.3) 的相等精确成功率；根到八叶上下文的共同处理器不可把 (52.5) 的两输入
+原始事件误差同时降至界下；全局域对应菜单必须有定理 53.2 的逐记录相等；
+额外联合仪器必须满足八记录律，而保留其拒绝系统输出还须满足定理 55.1。
+若物理读数违反某个合同，须检验完整输入、编码、仪器、独立性和概率对应中哪一项失效；
+不能由违反这些条件定理直接判定源本体或标量域。
+
+移动三源的叶数为 $1+2k_l,1+2k_l,1+4k_l$，$k_l=5l$；两个尺度可以不同。
+(54.3) 的统一间隙依赖这些移动标签，不给固定标签或统一原生取得成本。
+单孔放大的 $2^{5n}$ 叶成本与这些线性增长的梳树成本也不同。
+完整源族的秩仍按 (50.1) 无界，有限三源的张成空间和实际五模载体 $\mathbb C^5$
+仍须分别处理；§49 的五模原生障碍不能在未证载体对应时直接移作本双系统仪器的界。
+
+Renou 附录 E 的实量子网络排除要求其纠缠双源、三方结构、中心测量及外侧局域设置，
+正如[预测波第五卷假设 61.2](AURIC_COMPATIBLE_PREDICTIVE_WAVES_AND_RELATIONAL_SPECTRA_V.md)
+所限定；本中心固定记录测试不供应那些网络条件，且有 (55.3)–(55.4) 的有限实标签模拟。
+这里确定的是“源构造—独立乘积—保留联合拒绝”三个接口的不同数学义务。
+从这些条件推论到复结构的原生来源、Born／测量原则、可操作组合与动力学的闭合仍是
+未解决的问题；相对方向的可见性不等于绝对共轭方向的选择，也不等于完整量子起源。

+**命题 13.2（操作汇点不同于包含极大配置）。** 在一般的定义 9.1 中，每个包含
+极大配置都是操作汇点，反向不成立。特别地，取
+$E=\{a,b\}$、$\mathcal F=\{\varnothing,\{a,b\}\}$，则
+
+$$
+T=\mathcal F,\qquad N=\varnothing,\qquad \tau=0,\qquad m=2,
+\tag{MPC.41}
+$$
+
+而包含极大配置只有 $\{a,b\}$。
+
+**证明。** 合法单次新增会产生一个严格更大的族内配置，所以包含极大者没有合法
+新增。此例中两个单元集均不在 $\mathcal F$ 内，故从空集不能合法新增；满集
+也无新鲜事件。两个配置都是汇点，虽有严格包含关系。初态可能是任一汇点，所以
+读出必须区分两者；直接分别编码即可，给出 (MPC.41)。$\square$
+

+**命题 51.3（源标签、环境信息与小缺陷的界限）。** 定理 51.2 不禁止在完整树语法上
+计算构造子，也不禁止在另供目标态制备服务下读取正交标签后重制备。它排除的是定义 51.1
+的固定辅助输入合同。小的核乘法缺陷 (45.8)、(46.10) 本身不提供成功趋一的精确
+构造／分解，也不等同于近似通道的误差界。
+
+证明。若完整可读标签为 $|s,t\rangle$，不同来源输入的 Gram 内积为零；定理 51.2
+计算的输入内积不再适用。测标签后调用另供的制备，数学上可给所需输出，但该服务及
+源标签均在完整合同中增加资源。反之，固定辅助态不改输入内积，所以同一定理仍适用。
+两项缺陷上界随 $n$ 消失，而 (51.2)、(51.3) 的极限严格小于一；这是精确带旗标转换
+的反例。它不计算允许有误差时的最优成功率，也不把成功概率损失称为态距离。∎

+**定理 54.2（完整原始律、相对方向间隙及其退化）。** 对尺度 $l\in\{n,m\}$，令
+$k_l=5l$，并记实际三源的
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+x_l&=|\langle v_{W_{1,k_l}},v_{W_{0,k_l}}\rangle|^2
+     =a_l^2b_l^{k_l},\\
+y_l&=|\langle v_{W_{2,k_l}},v_{W_{1,k_l}}\rangle|^2
+     =a_l^2b_l^{2k_l}(b_l^2+h_l^2)^{k_l},\\
+z_l&=|\langle v_{W_{2,k_l}},v_{W_{0,k_l}}\rangle|^2
+     =a_l^2b_l^{3k_l},\\
+B_l&=\mathcal B_l=a_l^3[b_l^3(b_l+ih_l)]^{k_l}.
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{54.2}
+$$
+
+向量均取各自尺度，内积第一项共轭线性。令
+$x=x_n,y=y_n,z=z_n$、$x'=x_m,y'=y_m,z'=z_m$、$X=xx'$，
+$B=B_n$，同向模型取 $D=B_m$，反向模型取 $D=\overline{B_m}$。
+则八记录完整律为下表，各行末尾都有 Stop：
+
+| $(\sigma,\tau,\upsilon)$ | 未归一原始概率 |
+| --- | --- |
+| $(+,+,+)$ | $Xyy'$ |
+| $(+,+,-)$ | $Xy(1-y')$ |
+| $(+,-,+)$ | $X(1-y)y'$ |
+| $(+,-,-)$ | $X(1-y)(1-y')$ |
+| $(-,+,+)$ | $zz'+Xyy'-2\operatorname{Re}(BD)$ |
+| $(-,+,-)$ | $z(1-z')+Xy(1-y')-2\operatorname{Re}[B(x'-D)]$ |
+| $(-,-,+)$ | $(1-z)z'+X(1-y)y'-2\operatorname{Re}[(x-B)D]$ |
+| $(-,-,-)$ | $(1-z)(1-z')+X(1-y)(1-y')-2\operatorname{Re}[(x-B)(x'-D)]$ |
+
+各项非负，前四项和为 $X$，后四项和为 $1-X$，总和为一。两方向律的差在前四项为零，
+在后四项按表中顺序为 $(\delta_{n,m},-\delta_{n,m},-\delta_{n,m},\delta_{n,m})$，其中
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+\delta_{n,m}
+&=p_{+}(-,+,+)-p_{-}(-,+,+)
+ =4\operatorname{Im}B_n\operatorname{Im}B_m\\
+&\ge4\left(\frac45\right)^{46}\sin^2 1>0,\qquad
+\lim_{\substack{n\to\infty\\m\to\infty}}\delta_{n,m}
+ =4e^{-8}\sin^2 1.
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{54.3}
+$$
+
+结论同时包含相同尺度 $n=m$ 和任意不同尺度 $n\ne m$。完整记录的总变差距离为
+$2\delta_{n,m}$。若遗忘任何一侧的局域结果，只保留 $\sigma$ 与另一侧结果，则所得
+四记录边缘律在两方向下相同。
+
+证明。记 $c=\langle u_1,u_0\rangle$、$d=\langle w_1^\varepsilon,w_0^\varepsilon\rangle$。
+联合正支向量为 $cd\,u_1\otimes w_1^\varepsilon$，给前四项。
+联合负支向量为
+
+$$
+\Xi^\varepsilon=u_0\otimes w_0^\varepsilon
+ -cd\,u_1\otimes w_1^\varepsilon.
+\tag{54.4}
+$$
+
+令局域效果 $E_+=|u_2\rangle\langle u_2|$、$E_-=I-E_+$，第二侧对应为 $E'_\pm$。
+破坏性仪器的迹效果就是它们，故负后两查询的质量为
+$\langle\Xi^\varepsilon,(E_\tau\otimes E'_\upsilon)\Xi^\varepsilon\rangle$。
+定义局域的三个数列
+
+$$
+\begin{array}{c|cc}
+ &+&-\\ \hline
+q_\tau&z&1-z\\
+t_\tau&y&1-y\\
+\kappa_\tau&B&x-B
+\end{array}
+\qquad
+\begin{array}{c|cc}
+ &+&-\\ \hline
+q'_\upsilon&z'&1-z'\\
+t'_\upsilon&y'&1-y'\\
+\kappa'_\upsilon&D&x'-D.
+\end{array}
+\tag{54.5}
+$$
+
+由闭路积的方向约定，
+$c\langle u_0,E_+u_1\rangle=\overline B$，而对补效果该数为 $x-\overline B$；
+第二侧分别为 $\overline D,x'-\overline D$。
+展开 (54.4) 的二次型即得统一公式
+
+$$
+p(+,\tau,\upsilon)=X t_\tau t'_\upsilon,\qquad
+p(-,\tau,\upsilon)=q_\tau q'_\upsilon
+ +Xt_\tau t'_\upsilon-2\operatorname{Re}(\kappa_\tau\kappa'_\upsilon).
+\tag{54.6}
+$$
+
+这是表中全部八项。每项是正效果上的二次型，故非负；
+$\sum q=\sum t=1$、$\sum\kappa=x$ 及其第二侧对应式给两个旗标质量
+$X$ 与 $1+X-2X=1-X$。计算始终使用未归一向量；零历史、零质量正负支均保留，
+不定义零支条件态。式 (54.2) 由 (45.20)–(45.21) 和 delta 项在互异三源上的消失给出。
+
+写 $B=p+iq$、$B_m=s+it$，则
+$\operatorname{Re}(BB_m)-\operatorname{Re}(B\overline{B_m})=-2qt$，
+给 (54.3) 的第一式。补效果的 $\kappa_-$ 虚部反号，所以差呈所列交错排列。
+绝对值之和为 $4\delta_{n,m}$，得到总变差距离；沿任一局域结果求和则相消。
+由 (45.19)，$1<\arg B_l<5/4<\pi/2$，且
+$|B_l|\ge(4/5)^{23}$，所以 $\operatorname{Im}B_l\ge(4/5)^{23}\sin1>0$。
+由 (45.25) 的 $B_l\to e^{-4+i}$ 得双尺度极限。∎

+**定义 10.2（取得符号数和启用击中数）。** 在同一个固定模型上，只优化已安装
+平稳读出的有效值域大小，定义
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+m(E,\mathcal F)
+ &=\min\{|r(\mathcal F)|:r\text{ 满足定义 9.2 的取得要求}\},\\
+\tau(E,\mathcal F)
+ &=\min\{|H|:H\subseteq E,\quad
+       H\cap\operatorname{En}(C)\ne\varnothing\ \text{对每个 }C\in N\}.
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{MPC.31}
+$$
+
+第一个最小值量化所有具有已知码表并已安装的确定性平稳读出，可任取其符号载体。
+恒等读出可在入口停止，故可行类非空。第二个最小值也存在，因为 $E$ 击中每个
+非空启用集；当 $N=\varnothing$ 时取 $H=\varnothing$，约定 $\tau=0$。
+
+这一计数只计算 $|r(\mathcal F)|$，不计算传感器准备、模型或码表、保留的命令、
+计算、总存储或物理时间。它不把一个尚未提供的读出算成观察者已经具有的端口，
+也不规定如何从给定的较粗端口制造所优化的读出。

+**定义 9.1（单次新增配置模型）。** 固定有限的具名事件集合 $E$ 和非空族
+$\mathcal F\subseteq\mathcal P(E)$。每个 $C\in\mathcal F$ 都是允许的初始配置；
+不另给初始大小、可达根或隐藏的入口限制。动作名就是 $e\in E$，其合法性和后继为
+
+$$
+\operatorname{En}(C)=\{e\in E\setminus C:C\cup\{e\}\in\mathcal F\},
+\qquad
+C\xrightarrow{e}C\cup\{e\}\quad(e\in\operatorname{En}(C)).
+\tag{MPC.27}
+$$
+
+定义操作汇点族和非汇点族
+
+$$
+T=\{C\in\mathcal F:\operatorname{En}(C)=\varnothing\},
+\qquad N=\mathcal F\setminus T.
+\tag{MPC.28}
+$$
+
+这里只按单个事件的实际合法新增定义汇点；$\mathcal F$ 不必是下闭族、理想族或
+从某个根逐步可达的族。来源在一次运行中只通过 (MPC.27) 改变，没有未记录的
+来源切换或自主更新。

+**Theorem 145.1 (Every compact minimizer is physically punctured; repo-derived).**
+For the source (142.1), for every $0<\eta\le\eta_0$, retain the
+anchor $h_0(\eta)=e/2+\eta f$ and exactly the nonlinear reflection-side
+minima $\mu_f(\eta),\nu_f(\eta)$ of Definitions 124.1 and 126.2.
+These minima are positive and attained, with
+
+$$
+\begin{gathered}
+\frac{c}{2(1+2/\tau)}\eta
+ \le\mu_f(\eta)\le\nu_f(\eta)\le M\eta,\\
+\boxed{\quad\nu_f(\eta)-\mu_f(\eta)\ge\frac{\eta}{20000}>0.\quad}
+\end{gathered}
+\tag{145.1}
+$$
+
+Every compact $\mu_f$ minimizer $(\gamma,h)$ obeys
+
+$$
+\boxed{\qquad a_-\eta\le|\gamma|\le a_+\eta,\qquad}
+\tag{145.2}
+$$
+
+with the strictly positive source constants in (144.1). Both extremal
+retention radii of Definition 131.1 are attained and satisfy
+
+$$
+0<a_-\eta\le r_f^-(\eta)\le r_f^+(\eta)\le a_+\eta.
+\tag{145.3}
+$$
+
+For the original punctured reflection side there is no alternative
+at error $\varepsilon<\mu_f(\eta)$, an alternative exists at
+$\varepsilon=\mu_f(\eta)$, and alternatives exist for every
+$\varepsilon>\mu_f(\eta)$. Thus its exact endpoint has type III of
+Theorem 132.1 throughout this interval. In particular the original
+finite anchored modulus satisfies
+$\omega_{\mathfrak s,h_0(\eta)}(\mu_f(\eta))\ge1/2$.
+
+*Proof.* Since $R>1$, $\eta_0\le1/(4R)<1/4$, so the anchor is
+strictly inside the original ball:
+$\|h_0(\eta)\|^2=1/4+\eta^2<1$.
+Theorem 126.3 applies with the explicit constants of §144 and gives
+positive attained minima, the first line of (145.1), and
+
+$$
+|\mu_f(\eta)-\eta m_f|\le E\eta^2,\qquad
+|\nu_f(\eta)-\eta n_f|\le E\eta^2.
+\tag{145.4}
+$$
+
+The strictly positive lower bound follows there from (124.3);
+compactness includes the full complex disk and full closed completion
+ball on the original half-ball
+$\operatorname{Re}(e^\dagger h)\le0$.
+By (143.8) and $\eta\le1/(40000E)$,
+
+$$
+\nu_f-\mu_f
+ \ge\eta\left(\frac1{10000}-2E\eta\right)
+ \ge\frac{\eta}{20000}.
+\tag{145.5}
+$$
+
+For every fixed admissible $h$, the only paired lift in changing
+retention from $0$ to $\gamma$ is $(0,0,\gamma K_h)$.
+Since $\|K_h\|_{\rm HS}\le K$ on the whole ball and
+$\|r_i\|_{\rm HS}\le1$, the original weighted-row triangle inequality
+in (127.4) is
+$d_f(0,h;h_0)\le d_f(\gamma,h;h_0)+K|\gamma|$.
+At every compact minimizer this implies
+$K|\gamma|\ge\nu_f-\mu_f\ge\eta/20000$.
+The localization (126.9), valid for every minimizer, gives
+$|\gamma|\le G\eta$. This proves (145.2); compactness of the
+nonempty minimizer fiber then proves (145.3).
+
+All compact minimizers consequently have nonzero retention. The exact
+endpoint criterion of Theorem 124.2 proves the assertions at and on
+either side of $\mu_f$. Equivalently $r_f^->0$ and
+$\nu_f>\mu_f$, which is precisely type III in Theorem 132.1.
+Every reflected point has
+$\|h-h_0\|\ge|\operatorname{Re}(e^\dagger(h-h_0))|\ge A=1/2$;
+using a punctured minimizer in the original modulus proves its stated
+lower bound at equality. This deduction uses the actual nonlinear
+minima and every compact minimizer; the rational trial in (143.9)
+is neither asserted to minimize nor substituted for an actual law.
+
+For completeness, all lifted tangent witnesses used by Theorem 126.3
+are admissible on this same interval, since
+
+$$
+\|-Ae+\eta z\|\le\tfrac12+\eta R\le\tfrac34,
+\quad\operatorname{Re}(e^\dagger(-Ae+\eta z))\le-\tfrac14,
+\quad|\eta g|\le\tfrac12
+\quad(\|z\|\le R,\ |g|\le G).
+\tag{145.6}
+$$
+
+VI Theorem 106.3 realizes each actual pair by one full ten-dimensional
+completion with its five prescribed ready columns, shared over
+emission, the single forward return and all of that hypothesis's
+histories. A competing hypothesis may use a different such completion.
+The anchor's particular complex direction imposes no restriction on
+competitors. All raw prefix masses, both terminal labels, the factors
+$a_w/2$, the sole preparation, original menus, clocks and schedules
+are retained. No extra preparation, lottery, randomization, repetition,
+postselection, record phase, normalized replacement state or selected
+outcome enters these conclusions. $\square$

+**命题 13.1（最优基数不保证给定读出可取得）。** 令
+$E=\{a,b\}$、$\mathcal F=\mathcal P(E)$。此模型的最优符号数为 $3$，但下表

+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| $\varnothing$ | $\{a,b\}$ | $u$ | $a$ |

+**假设 14.1（从实际来源到有限配置的接口）。** 对一个待应用的实际来源，固定
+允许比较与运行的完整状态集 $S$ 及非空实际初态集 $S_0\subseteq S$。来源、纪元、

+$\widehat e$ 均为观察者已知，并满足
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+\widehat e\text{ 在 }s\text{ 合法}
+ &\iff e\in\operatorname{En}(\iota(s)),\\
+\iota(\widehat T_e(s))&=\iota(s)\cup\{e\}
+ \quad\text{在合法域上},\\
+\widehat r(s)&=r(\iota(s)).
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{MPC.42}
+$$

+**Theorem 144.2 (Source-only positive constants on the entire paired domain; repo-derived).**
+Every quantity in (144.1) is finite and strictly positive. In particular
+$\eta_0>0$. The constants $B,\kappa,c,C$ are valid decoder, retention
+and comparison constants in VI (118.7), VI (116.8) and VI (118.12),
+respectively, with $L_{\mathfrak s}=2$. For every original anchor and
+every admissible competing hypothesis, including the whole complex
+retention disk and the boundary of the completion ball,
+
+$$
+cD_0(\gamma,h;h_0)\le d_f(\gamma,h;h_0)
+ \le d_a(\gamma,h;h_0)\le CD_0(\gamma,h;h_0).
+\tag{144.2}
+$$
+
+*Proof.* The minor certificate gives $\det T\ne0$. At least one
+cofactor is nonzero, since an invertible matrix has nonzero inverse.
+Hence $\Lambda>0$ and is finite. Also $b,\tau>0$ and
+$m_0>0$, since $9>4\sqrt2$. These facts prove positivity of all
+successive constants in (144.1), including the finite minimum $\eta_0$.
+
+To check the decoder bound directly, choose the representative of a
+lift modulo (142.4) whose $X_{33}$ and $\operatorname{Im}Z_{33}$
+coordinates vanish. Its 34 remaining coordinates form a vector $v$;
+the first 34 row values form $Tv$. If the maximum absolute original
+row value is $d$, Cramer's rule gives $|v_l|\le\Lambda d$ for every
+$l$. The bases (142.6)–(142.7) consequently give
+
+$$
+\|X\|_{\rm HS}\le4\Lambda d,\quad
+\|Y\|_{\rm HS}\le4\Lambda d,\quad
+\|Z\|_{\rm HS}\le5\Lambda d.
+\tag{144.3}
+$$
+
+Indeed the squared Hermitian norm has at most three squared diagonal
+coordinates and twelve squared off-diagonal real coordinates; the
+squared complex-matrix norm has eighteen squared real coordinates.
+The gauge conditions only reduce these bounds. Set
+$v_0=(1,2,0)^{\mathsf T}/\sqrt5$ and
+$\Pi_{v_0}M=M-(v_0^\dagger Mv_0)I_3$.
+Then $v_0\perp a_+,t$ and
+$\|\Pi_{v_0}M\|_{\rm HS}\le p\|M\|_{\rm HS}$.
+The kernel-invariant maps VI (118.8) are here
+$(X+Y)/b$, $\Pi_{v_0}(X-Y)$ and $\Pi_{v_0}Z$.
+Their three output norms sum to at most $B d$ by (144.3).
+For physical paired lifts they are exactly
+$H_\delta,S_\delta,\Pi_{v_0}Z$, so this proves VI (118.7).
+
+For the retention bound use
+
+$$
+F=\begin{pmatrix}3/5&-4/5&0\\-4/5&-3/5&0\\0&0&0\end{pmatrix},
+\qquad \ell_F(M)=\operatorname{Tr}(FM).
+\tag{144.4}
+$$
+
+This is VI (116.6) with normalized $a_+$ and the vector $v_0$.
+It has trace zero and Hilbert–Schmidt norm $\sqrt2$, annihilates $t$,
+and satisfies $\ell_F(D)=5/8$. For the whole completion ball,
+$q_h=5/8-b\ell_F(hh^\dagger)\ge m_0$.
+The exact identity VI (116.14) and scalar invariance give
+
+$$
+q_h|\gamma-\gamma'|
+ \le2\sqrt2\|\Pi_{v_0}Z\|_{\rm HS}
+             +b\sqrt2\|H_\delta\|_{\rm HS}
+ \le\sqrt2(2+b)B d.
+\tag{144.5}
+$$
+
+Thus $\kappa$ is a valid retention constant for these same finite rows.
+Substituting $B,\kappa$ in VI (118.15)–(118.18), using
+$s_\theta^2=c_\theta^2=s_\theta c_\theta=1/2$, gives exactly
+$R_*,Z_*,c$ in (144.1). The upper estimate VI (118.19)–(118.21)
+gives $C$, because $\max_i\|r_i\|_{\rm HS}=1$ and
+$\|D\|_{\rm HS}=\sqrt{34}/8$. These estimates apply to any two
+points of the full closed parameter domain. Specializing one of them
+to $(0,h_0)$ proves (144.2).
+
+Finally (125.6) with $A=1/2$ gives the displayed $E$, and (126.3)
+gives exactly $R,G$. The number $\eta_0$ is at most the interval
+bound in (126.7) and at most $\Delta/(4E)$ for
+$\Delta=1/10000$. These are explicit source constants, not an
+unevaluated minimum over the completion or retention domains.
+The observability intermediate in VI §118 is D'Alessandro,
+[*On Quantum State Observability and Measurement*, §2, Theorem 1](https://arxiv.org/html/quant-ph/0307127v1),
+which identifies indistinguishability with annihilation of an
+observable linear span. The finite raw-row minor and all constants
+above belong to this particular source. $\square$

+**定理 53.2（完整有限局域记录不能定相对方向）。** 在假设 53.1 下，同向与反向模型
+对任意所述策略的完整原始记录有相同联合概率律，包括零质量历史、失败和 Stop。
+这尤其适用于实际移动三源
+$u_j=v_{W_{j,5n}}^{\mathrm c,n}$、$w_j=v_{W_{j,5m}}^{\mathrm c,m}$，$j=0,1,2$，
+以及各自的定义 47.1 破坏性菜单。
+
+证明。先固定随机种子。给定一个完整历史，初始未归一态是乘积；一条局域 CP 分支
+只作用一侧，故每个尚存前缀仍是正算子的乘积 $A\otimes B$。
+反向模型对应前缀为 $A\otimes\bar B$：第一侧操作不变，第二侧由 (53.1) 逐步保持对应。
+经典选择在两侧模型的同一个记录上相同，Stop 不改质量。由于
+$\operatorname{Tr}\bar B=\operatorname{Tr}B$ 对正迹类算子成立，每个前缀及叶的质量相同。
+若质量为零，两者都保留零算子，不取条件态。多 Kraus 支和局域失败重制备也服从同一对应。
+
+对可测种子空间 $(\Omega,\mu)$，用有限树中各分支的自然数编号形成可数的结果骨架字 $r$，
+记其固定种子质量为 $p_\omega(r)$；不用的叶置零。具体控制参数、消息和 Stop 位置是
+$(\omega,r)$ 的同一可测函数，可取连续值，不假定完整控制记录集可数。每个种子下两模型逐骨架相等且
+$\sum_rp_\omega(r)=1$，故对任意可测 $B\subseteq\Omega$，
+
+$$
+\Pr(\omega\in B,r)=\int_Bp_\omega(r)\,d\mu(\omega),
+\qquad \sum_r\int_\Omega p_\omega(r)\,d\mu(\omega)=1.
+\tag{53.2}
+$$
+
+Tonelli 定理给归一化，不需共同树深界；再由同一可测记录函数推前，得到完整控制记录的相等。
+同一可测经典后处理也保持相等。
+这里把 §47 的完整记录论证用于另供的两个独立载体，未把局域对应提升为联合仪器对应。∎
+

+**Proposition 145.2 (The finite certificate's remaining norm boundary).**
+Theorems 143.2–145.1 supply the strict gap and physical endpoint for
+$d_f$ with its literal 117-row maximum. They supply no strict gap
+$\delta_a$, no strict nonlinear inequality $\nu_a>\mu_a$ and no
+determined endpoint type for the separate full-history norm $d_a$.
+
+*Proof.* The lower witness (143.3) uses actual histories and therefore
+also gives $n_a\ge163/4000$. The upper certificate (143.10)–(143.12)
+contains exactly the histories of length at most two. It has no
+inequality for another history and gives no bound $m_a\le813/20000$.
+The already valid inequalities $m_f\le m_a$ and $n_f\le n_a$ do not
+bound $n_a-m_a$ from below by $n_f-m_f$. Likewise (144.2) compares
+norms, not their respective nonlinear optimum differences or their
+endpoint types. Thus no identification of the two norms is involved.
+The unresolved additional requirement is an original all-history
+upper certificate paired with an appropriate lower witness, or a
+separate exact nonlinear argument for the full-history minima.
+The finite nonlinear conclusion is conditional on the original
+return premises VI Assumption 106.2. It asserts neither an explicit
+nonlinear argmin or exact optimum value nor global originality or
+a resolution of an external named open problem. $\square$

+**命题 55.2（相同二值效果并非相同拒绝仪器）。** 令
+$P_A=|u_1\rangle\langle u_1|$、$P_B=|w_1^\varepsilon\rangle\langle w_1^\varepsilon|$，
+$Q_A=I-P_A,Q_B=I-P_B$。两侧分别作完整局域投影并保留四种结果时，
+把“都正”作为二值正、其余作为二值负，可在任意输入上匹配
+(54.1) 的二值概率。但负支的系统输出一般不同。
+
+证明。三个负结果的效果之和为
+
+$$
+Q_A\otimes P_B+P_A\otimes Q_B+Q_A\otimes Q_B
+=I-P_A\otimes P_B.
+\tag{55.2}
+$$
+
+因此完整四记录经明确的二值后处理给相同旗标概率，原四记录仍可保留。
+相应负输出是三个正交投影分支的非相干和，而 (54.1) 的负输出是它们先相加后
+夹乘输入，含不同负子空间间的交叉项。在定理 55.1 的乘积输入上，前者为可分离态，
+后者为纠缠纯态，故二者不同。后续两次破坏性查询会再破坏系统相干性，
+只保留终端记录的测试与保留联合负支系统输出的仪器要求也必须分开。
+
+为界定上述终端记录对源与输出的约束，应用 Renou 等，
+[*Quantum theory based on real numbers can be experimentally falsified*，
+2101.10873v2，附录 D，式 (4)–(6)](https://arxiv.org/html/2101.10873v2)
+的独立有限制备至中心节点模拟作为中间步骤。
+固定有限非空的第一、第二局域制备标签集 $I,J$，固定尺度、方向及假设 54.1 的中心操作与后续查询。
+记完整八记录为 $r$，其对独立制备 $(i,j)$ 的概率为 $p(r|i,j)$。
+整个顺序测试可作为中心节点上的八结果 POVM：若
+$R_+=P_1^\varepsilon$、$R_-=I-P_1^\varepsilon$，则
+
+$$
+H_{\sigma\tau\upsilon}
+=R_\sigma(E_\tau\otimes E'_\upsilon)R_\sigma\succeq0,
+\qquad \sum_{\sigma,\tau,\upsilon}H_{\sigma\tau\upsilon}=I.
+\tag{55.3}
+$$
+
+其 Born 表即 $p(r|i,j)$，已包含全部失败和 Stop。
+在实空间 $\mathbb R^I\otimes\mathbb R^J$ 中分别独立制备 $|i\rangle$、$|j\rangle$，
+令中心效果为
+
+$$
+M_r=\sum_{i\in I,j\in J}p(r|i,j)|i,j\rangle\langle i,j|.
+\tag{55.4}
+$$
+
+所有系数非负且逐 $(i,j)$ 求和为一，所以 $\{M_r\}$ 是实对角 POVM，
+$\langle i,j|M_r|i,j\rangle=p(r|i,j)$。可以用经典抽样输出该三位记录及 Stop；
+它精确匹配联合记录，并非只匹配一个成功率。
+它把不同标签编码成正交实向量，不要求保持 (45.13) 的源 Gram，也未供应 (54.1) 的条件系统输出。
+对每侧有限互异的实际源标签，源投影混合态的 $e_t$ 对角元由 (45.13) 等于 $r_l$ 乘以对应权重，且 $r_l>0$，
+故权重唯一；此编码在该有限源凸包上可按相同权重作仿射延拓。
+该仿射延拓本身不供应允许菜单中的物理转换，故此记录表模拟不与定理 51.2、55.1 冲突。
+对有限多中心测试设置也可逐设置定义相应 POVM；这不供应保持空间分离局域菜单的网络模拟。∎
+

+**假设 14.1（从实际来源到有限配置的接口）。** 对一个待应用的实际来源，固定
+允许比较与运行的完整状态集 $S$ 及非空实际初态集 $S_0\subseteq S$。来源、纪元、
+参考和权限所需字段均属于状态或固定合同。若要恢复该完整状态，须给出单射
+$\iota:S\hookrightarrow\mathcal F$，其在实际像上的逆码表以及每个事件 $e$ 对应的实际具名动作
+$\widehat e$ 均为观察者已知，并满足
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+\widehat e\text{ 在 }s\text{ 合法}
+ &\iff e\in\operatorname{En}(\iota(s)),\\
+\iota(\widehat T_e(s))&=\iota(s)\cup\{e\}
+ \quad\text{在合法域上},\\
+\widehat r(s)&=r(\iota(s)).
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{MPC.42}
+$$
+
+动作后继留在 $S$ 中，事件名可由实际成功记录忠实保留；$\widehat r$ 是入口和
+每次成功后确实可读的平稳端口。观察者还须满足定义 9.2 的初始化与输入限制，
+运行中保持同一来源，不用未记录的更新、时钟或建议补充读数。
+本接口合同不要求读出支持取得；常值实际读出也可满足 (MPC.42)，接口符合性
+本身不保证成功取得。
+
+若实际任务只恢复配置而非完整来源，则可以改用非单射 $\iota$，但此时结论只
+关于 $\iota(s)$。若实际初态像 $\iota(S_0)$ 严格小于 $\mathcal F$，则定理 10.3 关于
+**全部** $\mathcal F$ 初态的下界不自动成为该受限入口任务的下界。
+
diff --git a/Meta/Digestion/atoms/sha256/79e3007908f53f31f7f314d269e43bbf450cf7cd0ceae8e138e1ec78d0749c01 b/Meta/Digestion/atoms/sha256/79e3007908f53f31f7f314d269e43bbf450cf7cd0ceae8e138e1ec78d0749c01
